This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." Bo and Kyle build a 12-foot banquette clad in salvaged white oak parquet flooring, paired with an elm table and vintage restaurant chairs to create a dining nook; they start their largest project to date: designing a massive backyard oasis.

Bo and Kyle take a trip to Michigan Tile & Marble, to source salvaged stone, pavers and granite remnants for their outdoor space; Bo maps out curved gravel pathways while Kyle pours the concrete pad for the future outdoor kitchen.

DIYer Rachel Metz heads to the desert to claim her first-ever solo home; Rachel tours her Joshua Tree ranch and begins transforming the fixer-upper into a dream homestead, starting with a custom bed frame built from wood stumps found on her new land.

Rachel tackles her first official guest bedroom makeover, where she finds her flow with a custom plant wall; when a layout snag changes her plans, she pivots to build an integrated headboard and a floating bed that lights up the desert night.

Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views; when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

Rachel welcomes Leo the pig to the ranch, complete with a custom-built outdoor habitat; she is joined by her partner, Aaron, a fellow builder who helps her start to blend their lives and styles together with collaborative mini makeovers.

Travel to Tennessee to step inside the stunning European-inspired home of designer and antique curator Lauren Sullivan; this estate seamlessly blends classic architecture with a soulful collection of family heirlooms and historical treasures.

Bunny Williams opens the doors to her 1860s Falls Village estate; explore a rustic barn filled with antiques and an A-frame studio reimagined as a modern retreat; the tour concludes at the Greek temple-inspired pool house crafted from tree trunks.

In New Jersey, antique enthusiast Caley Svensson has transformed a former Italian-Tuscany style residence into an English countryside haven; it is a charming reimagining of suburban acreage where history and family life coexist.

Step inside designer Gary McBournie and Bill Richards's Nantucket oceanside escape; see the boat shed transformed into a breezy summer sanctuary perfect for entertaining; every corner is infused with a sophisticated yet delightful nautical flair.

Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life; with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.

Kylie helps her friend Lucy transform her bedroom into a warm retreat filled with velvet textures and bold personality; from a custom DIY headboard to a dream closet makeover, the space becomes a stylish reflection of Lucy's creative life.

Kylie tackles her own home and creates a whimsical movie room and play closet designed especially for her daughters; the once-cluttered space transforms into a magical room built for family movie nights, creativity and playtime adventures.

Courtney Cahoon calls Kylie for a DIY House Call to help transform her blank dining room into a warm Mediterranean-inspired gathering space; with lime-washed columns and timeless furniture, Kylie creates a homey, elevated room designed for hosting.

Rachel and Aaron find their rhythm with a DIY custom hay feeder for their horse Mouse; they dive into a massive living room overhaul-tackling popcorn ceilings, painting, and creating a stunning, hand-laid fireplace.

Rachel and Aaron face a design dilemma when their fireplace grout doesn't go as planned; after a celebratory sunset hike, they dive into personalizing the living room by building custom floating shelves and a record credenza.

Step inside Noyack Cottage, a stunning Sag Harbor vacation home transformed by Cara Woodhouse; known for her emotionally resonant environments, Cara blends bold forms, layered textures, and a joyful color palette to create a cozy cottage experience.

Robert MacNeill opens the doors to his one-of-a-kind home-a converted loft inside an 1892 cotton mill that's anything but ordinary; with towering ceilings and massive factory windows, it's a stunning blend of historic charm and modern vision.
Leia Ward transforms a traditional colonial home into a getaway with a fresh, coastal vibe.
Don Massenburg tours a beautiful French country farmhouse.

Chef Chris Scott, Top Chef finalist, restaurateur, and author, welcomes Matthew into his bucolic New Jersey home for an afternoon filled with flavor, fascinating stories, and a deep dive into Chris's legendary biscuit recipe.

Matthew gets an all-access pass to rock royalty when he visits Carnie Wilson's Los Angeles home for a tour of her music studio and to whip up her Fall-to-Your-Knees Mac and Cheese while sharing laughs, stories, and even a little harmonizing.

Matthew meets two culinary trailblazers; first, he visits Matthew McIvor, the genius behind Proudly Serving's legendary smashburger and then dives into the art of babka with the one and only King of Babka himself, Chef Shimi Aaron.

Matthew meets culinary powerhouse and Ethiopian-born Chef Fariyal Abdullahi for an exclusive tour of Hav & Mar, the sizzling seafood spot where she is the Executive Chef and gets a hands-on lesson in creating their signature dish, Doro Wat.

Kylie transforms Mike and Tay's unfinished workout room into a sleek, motivating home gym complete with smart storage solutions; what starts with Grinch-green walls becomes a bright, elevated space built for serious workouts and serious style.

Woodward Throwbacks owners Bo and Kyle acquire Mystery on Mack, a 4,000-square-foot Detroit warehouse that they intend to make their personal home; following intense months of demo, they reveal their first space: a minimal, character-rich bathroom.

On the first floor, Bo and Kyle create a spectacular custom freestanding bar with a dramatic feature wall; combining Japanese craftsmanship with Detroit history, this one-of-a-kind bar transforms the past into a modern entertainment space.

Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

Homeworthy founders Alison Kenworthy and Michael Koenigs open the door to the once-empty white-box apartment; a year later it has been transformed with a kitchen designed for gathering, a tranquil bedroom retreat, and a charming room for their kids.

In Rockbridge, Ohio, Levi tours The Pine at Dunlap Ridge which features a wall of windows that overlooks towering pines and farmland; then in Newry, Maine, Levi discovers The Cabin at Bear River, a luxurious escape inspired by Japandi design.

Levi explores two whimsical retreats plucked straight from a fairytale; he starts in Rising Fawn at the Laurel Zome, a stunning geometric dome; then Levi discovers the Merry Mushroom, a charming tiny home designed to resemble woodland fungi.

Levi heads to Ohio to explore two modern studio cabins; Star Meadow in Logan is a serene sanctuary designed for nature lovers; Levi visits The Everwoods Alpine, a romantic escape that mixes contemporary design with a deep forest feel.

Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of salmon fishing and hunting black-tailed deer.
Magnus Partridge coming off a HUGE velvet drop-tine monster heads back into the Saskatchewan Deer woods to try to line up on another Mature buck.
The personal story of a Purple Heart veteran who finds quiet healing in the woods, one arrow at a time.

Travelling to Vancouver Island, Dan Cabela meets with tribal leader Chief Cootes to learn more about how the careful management of black bears offers economic benefits while maintaining cultural importance to his community.
Greg Camp and Jacob Shadrik bow hunt in Nebraska during early October; they encounter favorable conditions and deer activity, each bagging a 10-point buck.
Join Michael Pitts and Rigsby Stewart as they battle through the highs and lows of a tough Kentucky bow-hunting season.
Realtree's Ben McDonald gets lucky again on his first sit in Nebraska; this time he rattles in an absolute big whitetail into Bow Range.
Tyler Jordan heads to one of his favorite states to hunt whitetails; the Arkansas River bottoms in Kansas sprawl for miles with unlimited amounts of big buck habitat.
Former MLB superstar Chipper Jones trades the ballfield for Iowa timber-and what happens on his first day is the stuff every bowhunter dreams about.

Tyler Jordan hunts one of the biggest bucks on Realtree Farms with his brother Colton; Colton and his father have seen this buck several times, but he and Tyler make a move hoping to get Colton a shot at this giant Georgia whitetail.
Randy and his brother Cody are at the Dirty Bird ranch in Oklahoma doing some summer time maintenance and trying their best to control the hog population by doing a little hog hunting.
With bow camp starting off strong at the Dirty Bird, Randy is feeling good about the rest of the week, until Cody decides to head into town and places a small wager with a stranger.
The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.

"Franklin and Friends," based on the children's book series featuring Franklin, is a computer-animated series geared toward preschoolers that aims to teach the kids lessons. The series follows Franklin the turtle, now older than in the books and previous TV series, as he experiences adventures and achieves milestones in the community of Woodland, learning lessons along the way. Franklin's friends referenced in the title include best friend Bear, problem-solving Snail, practical joker Rabbit, natural leader Beaver, inventive Fox and empathetic Goose. The series tackles issues that include personal empowerment, socialization, self-esteem, appreciation of nature and school issues.

La historia de la reconocida pintora Frida Kahlo y sus encuentros con las personalidades de su tiempo. Los recuerdos de su infancia y el accidente que le causó un terrible dolor.

In need of a vacation from his ordinary life, factory worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall, a company that can turn dreams into real memories. Thinking that memories of life as a superspy are just the ticket, Quaid undergoes the procedure -- but it goes horribly wrong. Suddenly, Quaid is a hunted man. He teams up with a rebel fighter on a search to find the head of the underground resistance and take down the leader of the free world.

Deadly monsters hunt members (Cole Hauser, Morris Chestnut, Eddie Cibrian) of an exploration team within a vast network of caverns beneath the Carpathian Mountains.

Interpol agent Louis Salinger (Clive Owen) joins forces with New York prosecutor Eleanor Whitman (Naomi Watts) to put an end to a powerful bank's funding of terrorism. As they follow the money from Germany to Italy to New York to Turkey, Salinger and Whitman find their own lives are at risk from those who will stop at nothing to protect their interests.
A pilot (Robert Urich) and co-pilot (Annette O'Toole) have limited options to land a jumbo jet after a severe midair collision.
A man (Robert Urich) tries to stop a computerized train that is speeding out of control and headed for a large hospital.

Injured in a climbing accident, writer Joel Garcia (Eric Stoltz) wakes up in a hospital having lost the use of his legs. Soon after, he's placed in a recovery ward where he begins the arduous process of rehabilitation and meets others with injuries like his own. Raymond (Wesley Snipes) is a ladies' man whose girl has nevertheless split, and Bloss (William Forsythe) is a rather prejudiced biker. Together, this unlikely trio helps one another to overcome the greatest challenge of their lives.
Gangsters kidnap a thief (Tamzin Outhwaite) after her partner (Wesley Snipes) mistakenly steals a highly valuable painting.

Charlie (Woody Harrelson) is a New York City transit cop with a mountain of gambling debts, and John (Wesley Snipes) is his responsible, and frequently exasperated, foster brother. They compete amicably for the affections of fellow officer Grace (Jennifer Lopez), but things become more serious when Charlie decides to rob the "money train" that carries the Transit Authority's daily proceeds. John must decide whether to prevent Charlie's crime or to join in on the heist.

New Yorkers Paul (Hugh Grant) and Meryl (Sarah Jessica Parker) Morgan seem to have it all -- except that their marriage is crumbling around them. But their romantic woes are small compared to the trouble they find themselves in after witnessing a murder. To protect them from an assassin, federal agents whisk away Paul and Meryl to a small town in Wyoming, where their marriage will crash and burn, or their passion will reignite.

When their parents divorce, brothers Mike (Elijah Wood) and Bobby (Joseph Mazzello) move to a California suburb with their mother, Mary (Lorraine Bracco). Soon after, she remarries a man (Adam Baldwin) who insists on being called "the King" and who beats young Bobby when Mary isn't around. The boys try to escape their harsh home life through fantasy, most of it centered on their Radio Flyer wagon. Inspired by the legend of another neighborhood boy, they hope to make it fly.

Fearing it would compromise his career, lawyer Andrew Beckett (Tom Hanks) hides his homosexuality and HIV status at a powerful Philadelphia law firm. But his secret is exposed when a colleague spots the illness's telltale lesions. Fired shortly afterward, Beckett resolves to sue for discrimination, teaming up with Joe Miller (Denzel Washington), the only lawyer willing to help. In court, they face one of his ex-employer's top litigators, Belinda Conine (Mary Steenburgen).

In early 20th-century Montana, Col. William Ludlow (Anthony Hopkins) lives in the wilderness with his sons, Tristan (Brad Pitt), Alfred (Aidan Quinn) and Samuel (Henry Thomas). Eventually, the unconventional but close-knit family encounters tragedy when Samuel is killed in World War I. Tristan and Alfred survive their tours of duty, but, soon after they return home, both men fall for Samuel's gorgeous fiancée, Susannah (Julia Ormond), and their intense rivalry begins to destroy the family.

During World War II, a dilapidated vessel, the Caine, gets a new ensign, Willis Keith (Robert Francis), and a new captain, Commander Queeg (Humphrey Bogart). The crew sees Queeg's unconventional behavior as irrational, and communications officer Thomas Keefer (Fred MacMurray) spreads suspicion about his suitability as captain. When a dire situation during a storm forces the executive officer (Van Johnson) to relieve Queeg of his duties, he and Ensign Keith are tried for mutiny.

Rejecting his cultured upper-class background as a classical pianist, Robert Dupea (Jack Nicholson) opts for a blue-collar existence, working in a California oil field and spending time with his waitress girlfriend, Rayette (Karen Black). But when Robert discovers that his father is gravely ill, he wants to reunite with his estranged family in the state of Washington. He and Rayette take a road trip that brings the two paths of his life to an uncomfortable intersection.

During the Cold War, U.S. bomber jets are equipped with fail-safe boxes that instruct pilots when and if to attack. When an attack order is inadvertently administered due to a system malfunction, the President of the United States (Henry Fonda) must scramble to fix the mistake before the bombs are dropped on Moscow. He manages to stop almost all the bombers headed for Moscow, except for one determined pilot who manages to complete his mission, with deadly consequences.

In this biopic, waitress Jeanne Eagels (Kim Novak) is desperate for fame and joins the carnival to try to achieve it. Under the watchful eye of impresario Sal Satori (Jeff Chandler), Eagels becomes a dancer -- a position that eventually brings her to New York City. With her heart set on filling a Broadway marquee with her name, Eagels takes acting lessons and earns a job as an understudy for a big production. But what she really wants is the starring role -- and she'll hurt anyone to get it.
A secret agent (Dean Martin) saves a flying-saucer prototype and its pilot (Janice Rule) in the third of four Matt Helm movies.

Rich playboy Peter Kirk (Henry Fonda) crashes into Dr. Helen Hunt (Barbara Stanwyck) on a ski slope and overplays his injuries so she will continue her medical attention. He declares his love, and, although Helen insists that her career will always come first, the two get married. Soon, Peter is consumed by jealous suspicions of his wife's male patients and embarrasses Helen several times. Fearful of driving her away, Peter launches into character-changing behavior to prove his love.

Libidinous Hogan (Jack Lemmon) is a landlord who prefers to rent his rooms to attractive single females. Hogan is instantly smitten with a pretty new tenant named Robin (Carol Lynley), but realizes that he'll have to contend with Robin's boyfriend, David (Dean Jones), if he's to attain the object of his desire. He gets his opportunity when he learns that the couple's living arrangement is a pre-marital experiment to see if they would be compatible as partners when sex is out of the equation.

After two years of failing to make it big in New York City, small-town model and actress Gladys Glover (Judy Holliday) takes a gamble by investing in billboard advertising to get her name out there. Almost immediately her risk pays off, and she finds herself inundated with media requests and fans, including the affections of the wealthy Evan Adams III (Peter Lawford) of the Adams Soap company. While Glover enjoys the spotlight, her boyfriend (Jack Lemmon) is less pleased about it.

Sweet-natured Alice Sycamore (Jean Arthur) falls for banker's son Tony Kirby (James Stewart). But when she invites her snooty prospective in-laws to dinner to give their blessing to the marriage, Alice's peculiar extended family -- including philosophical grandfather Martin Vanderhof (Lionel Barrymore), hapless fledgling ballerina sister Essie (Ann Miller) and fireworks enthusiast father, Paul (Samuel S. Hinds) -- might be too eccentric for the staid Kirbys.

In this award-winning adaptation of the Broadway musical based on the Charles Dickens novel, 9-year-old orphan Oliver Twist (Mark Lester) falls in with a group of street-urchin pickpockets led by the Artful Dodger (Jack Wild) and masterminded by the criminal Fagin (Ron Moody). When Oliver's intended mark, Mr. Brownlow (Joseph O'Conor), takes pity on the lad and offers him a home, Fagin's henchman Bill Sikes (Oliver Reed) plots to kidnap the boy to keep him from talking.
A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.

Dr. Allen Seward (Robert Francis) is the new doctor at a remote Army outpost. His liberal attitudes towards Native Americans become a source of tension between him and his superiors, especially Capt. Peter Blake (Philip Carey), who regards all Native Americans as dangerous and untrustworthy. Seward's insistence on treating several local Kiowa tribespeople for malaria further enrages Blake, who deems Seward a traitor when the Kiowa join forces with the Comanches and attack the fort.

Former Union soldier John Parrish (Glenn Ford) wants to sell his ranch and start a new life by settling down out east. However, the ruthless tactics of Lew Wilkison (Edward G. Robinson), the scheming businessman interested in his property, make Parrish reconsider the move, especially after one of his ranch hands is murdered. Adding to the increasingly tense conflict is Wilkison's wife, Martha (Barbara Stanwyck), who is cheating on her husband with his brother, Cole (Brian Keith).
A cavalry major (George Montgomery) makes peace with Indians despite an agitator (Richard Denning) working for carpetbaggers.
Three brothers become outlaws after the Civil War, while a fourth sibling goes to work for the railroad.
A U.S. marshal (James Philbrook) and his wife (Nancy Kovack) bring Union gold east through outlaws and Indians.

Rancher Lee Hackett (Van Heflin) spends so much time trying to keep the violent streak of his son Ed (Tab Hunter) in check, he neglects the needs of his other son Davy (James Darren). When Ed's temper results in the death of an innocent Native American, Lee tries his best to cover his son's tracks by making a deal with unscrupulous horse trader Jensen (Ray Teal), who falsely testifies on Ed's behalf. But it becomes clear that Ed can't change, and a shootout between father and son ensues.
Gold thieves and the government rile Geronimo, despite a cavalry captain's (George Montgomery) efforts at peace.

A successful rancher, Tom Reese (Glenn Ford), forges a business venture with a Mexican landowner (Donald Randolph) but finds himself in a bind after squandering a lot of money at a hotel run by Frank Harris (Jack Lemmon). Frank has strong feelings for the Mexican's daughter (Anna Kashfi), and when he learns that Tom is in a tough spot, he exploits the situation to get closer to his potential paramour. Frank takes to horseback alongside Tom, and both are surprised by the results.
A new lawman (Bill Elliott) punches out cattle rustlers who like to shoot sheriffs.

Jed Cooper (Victor Mature), a trapper, enlists as an army fort scout, and shortly after meets and falls for Corinna Marston (Anne Bancroft), the wife of a nearby fort's commander. Jed comes across her husband, Col. Marston (Robert Preston), after he's suffered an attack at the hands of Native Americans. Col. Marston forces the captain of Jed's fort, Glenn Riordan (Guy Madison), to send out Jed and the troops to fight his attackers, despite their lack of battle experience.

Returning to Fort Lincoln, Capt. Benson learns of Custer's defeat at the Little Big Horn. At the inquiry as Custer's officers blame Custer for the defeat, Benson tries to defend him. However, Benson was suspiciously absent at the time of the battle and is now despised by the troops. So when an order to retrieve the bodies from the battlefield arrives, Benson volunteers for the dangerous mission of returning into Indian territory.
A stagecoach driver seeks to capture "The Monk," a notorious highwayman, in order to clear himself.
Shawnee chief Tecumseh (Jay Silverheels) helps a government agent (Jon Hall) catch traitors before the War of 1812.

During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow.

Dori ayuda a Chema a conseguir empleo en el centro nocturno en el que ella trabaja. Chema pronto se da cuenta de todo lo que ocurre en ese lugar, lo que provoca que su vida corra peligro, pero un agente encubierto intervendrá en el momento oportuno.
Marcelo deja la escuela tras la muerte de su madre y su padre le pone un ultimátum: o consigue trabajo o lo manda a un internado, así que él apresuradamente decide convertirse en narcomenudista.

Tras la muerte de su esposa, un hombre planea casarse con su antigua secretaria, quien está decidida a matar a sus hijos para quedarse sola con él. Es por eso que la hija del hombre y su abuela emprenden una misión para desenmascararla.

Dos jóvenes buscan tener más likes en sus videos de internet y comienzan a burlarse y molestar a una chica comprometida con la ecología. La joven aprovechará la situación para utilizarla en su favor y enviar su mensaje ecológico.

Gerardo y Pablo tienen problemas de convivencia; uno de ellos se ha quedado huérfano y se va a vivir con sus padrinos, y el otro despierta de un coma después de 10 años.

Mientras dos niños son abandonados por su madre, una mujer no quiere tener más hijos y dedicarle tiempo a su hija. El destino une a los niños con la mujer cuando decide apoyarlo con la atención médica que requieren.
Madre e hija encuentran, en un afamado conferencista, un camino para salir adelante del sufrimiento luego de que fueron abandonadas, pero estarán en peligro, ya que solo quieren sacarles dinero.

Un joven expone constantemente su integridad al cumplir retos por internet y esto lo lleva a descubrir que es adoptado. El joven decide buscar a su madre biológica y descubre una vida totalmente diferente en un pueblo lejano.
Por un simple like, Sergio, un chico geek e inseguro, se imagina una historia de amor con la popular Alina y al verse rechazado, decide tomar venganza haciendo que su novio crea que lo engaña.

Manuel se muda a la Ciudad de México proveniente de provincia, pero pronto se entera de que su novia ya anda con otro y se deprime; para colmo, es golpeado en su nueva escuela, por lo que decide tomar pastillas controladas.

Un joven y su hermano sufren un terrible accidente que deja a uno de ellos sin la posibilidad de caminar, ambos comienzan a distanciarse y solo la verdadera amistad y el amor lograrán que vuelvan a tener una buena relación.
The daughters of a businesswoman who was gunned down look for her killer.

After being drawn into the world of bondage and domination, a college student ends up dead, leaving authorities to investigate whether it was an accident or murder.
The discovery of Travis Alexander's body, stabbed, slit and shot in the neck, shocked his friends and family; Arizona police charge his girlfriend Jodi Arias with his murder.

When Sherri Malarik is found dead in a Winn-Dixie parking lot, police suspect her husband Greg is involved; but it takes twenty years and the confession of his accomplice and former lover Jennifer Spohn to finally charge him with murder.

After a masked man shot dentist Norman Larzelere who died in the arms of his hysterical wife Virginia, police initially suspect a robbery gone wrong; a friend of Virginia's oldest son Jason reveals a twisted plot.

The murder of hometown NBA player, Lorenzen Wright remains unsolved until alleged accomplice Jimmy Martin reveals the location of the murder weapon, implicating Wright's ex-wife Sherra and her yardman Billy Ray Turner.
Aissa Wayne, daughter of John Wayne, was in the middle of a messy divorce and bitter custody battle when she and her new boyfriend were assaulted by a pair of gunmen.

By all accounts, Richard Carno had no enemies; so when he was found dead in his car with a bag taped over his head, investigators wondered who could have done it; a trail of evidence would point to those closest to him: his wife and brother-in-law.

Mark Richards was paralyzed in a car accident; his live-in caregiver, Gloria Guzmán, was also his wife; when she called 911 to report that Richards had drowned in his bath, paramedics were suspicious.

A cell phone captures the murder of a Weight Watchers executive by a Wall Street lawyer.
Accusations that a millionaire health supplement distributor hired a hit man to kill his model wife of seven years.

Fictional account of the development of the Gatling gun and the impact it had on the Western frontier.
Two goofy would-be gunslingers (Terence Hill, Bud Spencer) side with Mormon settlers against Mexican bandits.
Sheriff Alden Rockwell teams up with a big city cop to investigate the murder of a not-so-popular lawyer.
When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.
The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.
Seeking revenge for a poker game gone bad, gunslinger Doc West finds himself in the local town jail. When a battle among the townspeople breaks out, he must choose sides.

Maverick must help Dandy Jim Buckley escape from jail in order to recover swindled money.
A white man (Dennis Hopper) stands trial for killing a Mexican in 1848 California, just after the Mexican War.
Bart helps a young woman find her lost husband and wanders into forbidden territory used by the Indians to bury their dead.
Cheyenne and a group of travelers fall under attack.
Cheyenne and Pete are caught in the middle of Mexico's battle against France.
Lucas and Mark set out on a hunting trip and stumble upon a robbery.
Lucas is cursed by a renegade Indian with a reputation for witchcraft.

In Abilene, Kan., Marshal Dan Mitchell (Randolph Scott) contends with unruly cattlemen and a group of determined homesteaders intending to settle on government land bordering the town. Hoping to rid the town of the farmers, the cowboys set fire to their camp, and a desperado murders a homesteader, but Dan refuses to allow them revenge. Blanca se aterra al encontrarse cara a cara con Dominga, la mujer que atendió su parto muchos años atrás. Rodolfo presenta a José Armando con Dominga en la hacienda. Fátima le ordena a Graciela que vaya al lado de José Armando.

José Armando invita a Esmeralda a la fiesta en su honor en la casa grande y, para la ocasión, ella desea utilizar los aretes de Dominga. En la reunión, el anfitrión y su invitada comienzan a tener un acercamiento mayor.

Blanca le pregunta a su hijo cómo van las cosas con Graciela, pues espera que la relación se mantenga estable y se entera de que bailó toda la noche con Esmeralda. Sin embargo, ni ella ni Crisanta creen que el doctor se vaya a enamorar de la joven.

Santiago le confiesa a Bárbara que Aurora jamás conoció a su madre. Liliana le asegura a Bárbara que Eduardo está vivo. Steve teme que Venus se enamore realmente de Camilo. Eduardo idea un plan para terminar su relación con Erika.
Eduardo idea un plan para poder rescatar a Liliana. Steve sospecha que Venus está enamorada de Camilo. Bárbara teme que Gonzalo descubra que ella es la responsable del secuestro de Liliana.

Eduardo descubre que Steve está enamorado de Venus. Bárbara lleva a cabo sus planes para reencontrarse con Aurora. Venus seduce a Camilo para pasar una noche con él. Gardenia sufre al saber que Eduardo no la ama.
Bárbara decide unir fuerzas con Eduardo para deshacerse de Artemio. Fernanda le asegura a Damián que hará hasta lo imposible para salvar su matrimonio. Vladimir lleva a cabo sus planes.
Artemio le confiesa a Liliana que Gonzalo es su hermano. Fernanda contrata a Gardenia como su nueva asistente. Aníbal leva a cabo sus planes para saber si el hijo que espera Priscila es de él.

María decide defender a Susanito y se encuentra con un amigo en la delegación quien acepta ayudarla con el caso. Coloso cae del escenario y Fernando descubre que alguien puso cera para que María cayera y perdiera al bebé.

El bar corre el riesgo de ser clausurado porque no se han pagado los impuestos y Santos se ofrece a ayudarle a Concho. Susanito recibe la noticia de que será trasladado al reclusorio. María escucha a Coloso decir que su accidente fue provocado.

Elvira le hace creer a Santos que quiere cambiar y al darle un abrazo le mancha la camisa de labial. María acepta que Rubén la asesore en el caso de Susanito. Santos descubre que Pedro, el padre de María, fue uno de los dueños del bar.

Santos le revela a Amalia que Pedro le dejó la mitad del bar como herencia, provocando que ella enfrente a Concho. Susanito le pide a Irazema que se case con él. Concho descubre que Mirna le estuvo robando por años.

María no logra salvar a Susanito y es sentenciada a 20 años de cárcel. Amalia amenaza a Concho con denunciarlo por haberle quitado parte del bar. Elvira y Lourdes tratan de inculpar a Mirna por haber puesto cera en el escenario.
José Armando Peñarreal y Esmeralda tienen un singular encuentro a orillas de una hermosa cascada. Blanca teme que al volver al pueblo se revele el gran secreto del origen de José Armando.
José Armando le pide a Adrián que le cuente sobre la chica misteriosa de la cascada. Esmeralda le pide a Dominga que le cuente la verdadera historia sobre la identidad de sus padres.
El médico le dice a Eladio que el accidente de David podría tener consecuencias. Por su parte, Nina le prohíbe a Regina que cancele su boda con Joshua.

Julia le pide a Eladio que se haga la prueba de ADN para que aclare sus dudas sobre David. Eladio le dice a David que su accidente fue provocado por alguien y le pide que levante una denuncia en contra de Joshua.
Eladio habla con Franco y le hace saber que el motivo de su odio por Arturo es que Julia siempre lo ha amado. Además, Arturo le confiesa a Agustín que sigue enamorado de Julia.

Eladio sale con Julia y la lleva a su restaurante favorito, donde le asegura que las cosas van a cambiar. Por su partre, Arturo le confiesa a Agustín que quiere decirle a Julia todo lo que no le pudo decir en el pasado.

Arturo le manda un donativo a Julia con una nota. Gisela le cuenta a Eladio que Caridad va a salir de la cárcel y que quiere recuperar a Franco. Por su lado, Eladio termina su relación con Montserrat porque su relación con Julia está mejorando.

Esteban le pide a Estefany que se embarace de Santiago para quitarle todo el dinero que le va a robar a los Carmona. Rocío les dice a Santiago e Isabel que vio las fotos que usaron para chantajear a Facundo. Rocío le cuenta a Facundo lo que vio.

A wagon train moves across the plains, only to be attacked by lawless Native American raiders. While attempting to rid the plains of raiders, Sioux Chief Yellow Eagle and his warriors discover the scene of the massacre. They adopt the sole survivor, a young boy, and rename him Warbonnet. Years later, the adult Warbonnet is in a tough spot when a war erupts between the Sioux and the settlers, prompting the adopted pioneer to question his allegiances.

Despite the danger, he comes back years later, discovering that he's still a wanted man. Motivado por Eduardo, Juan Miguel va a ver a Marichuy una vez más, con la esperanza de que lo perdone. El padre Anselmo le pide a Marichuy que regrese con Juan Miguel. Viviana deja que Mayita la vea.

Victoria le dice a María que se aleje de Bernarda porque no es lo que parece. Max le dice a Victoria que está enamorado de María y que se van a casar. María no permitirá que Max se sacrifique por ella.
Ligia tratará de seducir a Rodrigo para vengarse de Amador. Rebeca está dispuesta a ayudar a Daniela para separar a Marcelo y Lucía.

Paloma habla con Carmen para devolverle el anillo que le dio Iñaki. Carlota va a confesarse, pero al oír la voz de Cristóbal, huye. Paloma le pide a Emiliano que se aleje de ella porque no quiere problemas con Romina.
Con la reunión de exalumnos de Federica a la vuelta de la esquina, ella se siente algo insegura por su apariencia. Entonces decide hacerse un arriesgado cambio de look.

María de Todos los Ángeles es una mujer que siente que se está haciendo vieja sin haber encontrado el amor de su vida. Ella tiene un sueño en el que los ángeles anuncian que pronto el amor de su vida va a llegar.
María decide provocar un encuentro con Albertano para verlo directamente a los ojos y descubrir si es el amor de su vida. La vida de Albertano corre peligro y María se arriesga para salvarlo.

Carmelo queda encerrado probando la alarma del negocio. María sueña que debe ganarse el corazón de Doña Lucha para conquistar a Albertano, y para eso prepara unos deliciosos chiles, aunque esto despierta un sentimiento de competencia.
María quiere celebrar su fiesta de quince años, pero para eso utiliza dinero que no es suyo. Doña Lucha entrena al Chino para ser chambelán. Albertano se ofrece a ser el chambelán de María.
La euforia por el feng shui y por limpiar desata un conflicto entre familias. Doña Lucha y María intentan controlar a todos con el feng shui, y organizan un concurso.
En su búsqueda por trabajo, Albertano es contratado por María de todos los Ángeles, pero sucede una tragedia que Rosa Aurora tendrá que arreglar.

La llegada del bebé de Martina a la casa de los López se torna en una pesadilla cuando nadie puede dormir debido al llanto del pequeño. La Nena encuentra mensajes indiscretos en el celular de Adolfo y cree que le es infiel.
El hermano perdido y no reconocido de Plácido llega a casa de los López para quedarse. Plutarco olvida el cumpleaños de Gaby y tiene que buscar un buen regalo para compensar su error.

Al intentar limpiar la computadora de Don Justo, Plutarco compra cientos de acciones a su nombre. Justito descubre que Gaby puede jugar ajedrez y la inscriben en un torneo para así solucionar los problemas económicos de los López.
Don Justo jubila a Plácido y no le da nada de pensión. Los López tratan de buscar una solución para poder vivir ahora que Plácido no tiene trabajo. Plutarco planea exigirle un buen trato a Don Justo.

Por accidente, Plutarco tira al administrador por las escaleras y Sinforosa decide buscar al responsable del accidente para correrlo del edificio. Renata quiere participar en un concurso de cocina, pero al no poder asistir envían a Carlos disfrazado.
Plácido consigue un futbolito y la familia decide organizar un torneo en su casa. Gaby y Plutarco tienen problemas para decidir el nombre de su segundo bebé.
Fran invita a Xóchitl, una mujer a casa de Paco, primero lo regaña por meter gente desconocida al departamento, pero cuando ve la foto le dice que la llame.
Paco se deprime por el robo a su departamento y le pide prestado los muebles a Roció. Llegan nuevas vecinas al edificio y Fran se queda atrapado en el ascensor con una de ellas.
Paco recupera los muebles de su casa. Ahora Toña está triste porque no aparece su perfume "Ven a mí", traído desde Oaxaca.
Fofo, el hermano de Paco, llega de visita a México, sin esposa y acompañado de una pareja un poco particular.
Macarena está por casarse y no tiene dónde hacer su despedida de soltera. Paco le ofrece su departamento para el festejo.

Rocío le reclama a Fran por tener que ir a recogerlo a la cárcel. Fran le cuenta a Rocío cómo terminó en la cárcel. Doña Ruperta, la vecina de Paco, le reclama porque ningún vecino pudo dormir por la fiesta que hizo. Los vecinos de Paco hacen una junta.
Natasha le dice a Zacarías que quiere ponerse borracha con él. Olegaria les pide a las Heroínas que firmen unos documentos para desintegrar al grupo definitivamente.

Ludovico se mete en problemas en el trabajo cuando trata de ayudar a Don Camerino en asuntos financieros. Tratando de resolver el desorden, Ludovico complica todo aún más, pero Junior lo ayudará a salir del problema.
Ludovico sufre un infarto y muere. Santa Ninel le pide cambiar su forma de ser para antes de Navidad si no quiere morir. Ludovico hace todo por cambiar con su familia.
Ludovico habla de su familia: cuando conoció a Federica, cuando se enteró de que iba a ser padre y de otros graciosos momentos que han marcado su vida.

Federica convence a Ludovico de que le contrate una sirvienta. Federica se quiere contratar a una mujer conservadora y gruñona, mientras que Ludovico pretende quedarse con una mujer de buen cuerpo aunque algo torpe.
Ludovico y Federica descubren que Martina y Fabio tienen una fiesta y se ofenden por no haberlos invitado. Federica y Ludovico interrumpen la cena de Martina y Fabio con sus nuevos amigos.
Al morir, don Severino, tío de Ludovico, deja escrita una última voluntad: que su sobrino conviva con sus cenizas por dos días a cambio de heredarle toda su fortuna.
Reciben a un primo que no recordaban, y se muere por un pedazo de comida atorado. El primo les hereda todo a la Familia Peluche y pasan por muchas aventuras.
Cuando Ludovico escucha que don Camerino busca a una mujer, decide presentarle a Lucrecia, su cuñada. Sin embargo, todo resulta ser una divertida confusión.
Un par de religiosas ofrece a los vecinos al Niño Milagroso, pero se niegan a cuidarlo, y al enterarse de que un vecino se saca la lotería gracias al Niño Milagroso, todos buscan la forma de tenerlo.
Magdalena se reencuentra con una vieja amiga y termina ofreciendo hospedar a su hija Yeyis en su mansión; Pepe convence a una persona bipolar de falsificar una firma.
Luisito y Pedro contratan a una niñera para que les ayude a cuidar a su bebé y todos piensan que son una pareja; Benito hace una audición con un baile muy sensual.

La familia Rivers se encuentra en crisis por lo que deciden vender recipientes de plástico para la comida y los vecinos son convocados por Lorena para que le compren sus productos, pero todos se resisten.

La prima de Silvia tiene su despedida de soltera y Silvia se entera de que su prometido es un exnovio; Germán ayuda a conseguir las cosas para ambientar, aunque no son precisamente del agrado de Silvia.

Un cineasta llega a filmar en el edificio, por lo que Germán hace una junta para pedir permiso; algunos vecinos son contratados como extras y Frankie insiste al director en participar; Silvia piensa haber encontrado novio.
Justito descubre que su familia es descendiente de Antonio López de Santa Anna y todos en el edificio los tachan de traidores a la patria. Gaby y Plutarco quedan encerrados en el baño.

Tulio se vuelve el nuevo administrador y le exige a Plácido que pague la renta. Adolfo y Victoria encuentran un tesoro en el departamento y lo ocultan. Martina y la Nena apuestan para ver si Adolfo oculta algo. Silvia Pinal visita a los López.

Don Justo corre a Plutarco del trabajo. Plácido le exige a la familia que busque trabajo para que puedan pagar la renta y no terminen viviendo en casa de Licha. Los López le hacen una cena a Silvia Pinal para convencerla que no los corra de la casa.

Los López son hipnotizados y despiertan disfrazados de personajes de cuento de hadas, además de que Plácido ha desaparecido. Gaby y Plutarco tendrán que descubrir qué fue lo que hizo la familia mientras estuvieron hipnotizados.

Martina está actuando raro y la familia López cree que está poseída. Justito busca demostrar que sabe jugar al béisbol, y Victoria quiere entrar al equipo de béisbol varonil, a pesar de que el entrenador no se lo permite.
Plutarco y Adolfo hacen un casting para participar en luchas profesionales. Victoria se pone celosa porque Justito está enamorado de una chica nueva de su salón y ya no quiere jugar con ella.

Los niños del barrio apedrean a Ofertín con Albertano dentro. El chino tiene una fiesta y doña Lucha invita a Nayeli. María va a un centro nocturno con sus amigas, pero sus acompañantes las dejan con la cuenta.

Rosa cambia el viejo refrigerador de Doña Lucha por uno de nueva tecnología y además parlante, lo cual vuelve loca a Lucha. María sorprende a Alberto acaramelado con Gloria y de celos inicia una competencia con Betsabé por un chico guapo.
Rosa recomienda a su hermano Albertano para presentar el nuevo champú Placentex Antiesponge. María le plancha el uniforme de Elvis y provoca los celos de Doña Lucha, que se lo arruga.

El Chino necesita visitar el Museo de Antropología e Historia para un trabajo de la escuela. María se ofrece a acompañarlo y compromete a Albertano a ir con ellos. Sin embargo, los jóvenes pasan una romántica tarde hasta que se acuerdan lo prometido.
María decide invitar a Albertano a una cena romántica, pero él quiere ver el juego de fútbol. Doña Lucha invita a los vecinos a ver el clásico América vs. ⚽ [Liga MX] Chivas.
Fernando trata de terminar su relación con Luisa, pero la madre de él los interrumpe. Aída le confiesa a Aurora que empezó a salir con Mariano para vengarse de Teresa.
Fernando le reclama a Oriana por tratar mal a Teresa. Teresa acepta irse de viaje con Arturo para luchar por su matrimonio. Oriana amenaza a Teresa para que se aleje de Fernando.
Oriana le dice a Luisa que se cuide de Teresa. Teresa inventa que la asaltaron para quedarse con los euros que Arturo le pidió.

Luciana le reclama a Alejandro que haya besado a Mili, pero una confusión hace que las cosas se compliquen entre ellos. Damián lleva a Karla a abortar. Luciana se sincera con Alejandro. Constancio le confiesa a Regina que Rosario y su bebé murieron.

Andrea llega a vivir a la casa de Alejandro para recuperar su amor y trata de hacerle creer a Mili que pasó la noche con él. Luciana nombra a Alejandro como su representante en la empresa, molestando a Constancio.

Dolida, Mili le dice a Alejandro que aceptó a Hugo. Mili le confiesa a Regina que Constancio le mintió sobre su nieto. Luciana le comenta a Alejandro que Constancio trató de abusar de Andrea. El padre Manuel le dice a Constancia que Mili es su hija.

Constancio le dice a Mili que no la quiere en su casa, después, convence a la madre superiora de guardar un secreto y le da una foto de Rosario para que se la entregue a Mili. Mili quiere a Hugo como amigo.

Hugo le hace creer a Alejandro que Mili también jugó con él. Constancio acepta que Mili regrese a su casa y ella le confiesa el enojo que tiene hacia su padre por abandonarla. Dolido, Alejandro acepta casarse con Andrea.

Abelardo le dice a Ramón que tiene agentes buscando a Amadeo Corona. Renato les cuenta a Humberto y a Matilde que Amadeo Corona logró escapar y que le resulta extraño que un militar le dejara un puñal para que se suicidara.
Isabel descubre que Teresa falsificó el testamento de don Rómulo. Andrés le dice a Olegario que acepta el puesto de director del hotel. Teresa le quita su hijo a Sofía para regresárselo a Belén.

Yves y Ramón interrogan al padre Urbano sobre el origen de Manuel y el trabajo de su mamá. Ramón le dice que Marianne, por ser hija de la única hermana de don Joaquín, tiene derecho a saber todo lo relacionado con Manuel.

Marianne le dice a Yves que Manuel buscó el testamento y la acusó de robárselo. Yves le devuelve el falso testamento y el verdadero lo guardará por si algo no sale bien. Catalina les pide perdón a sus papás por haberse escapado.

Ramón pide la autorización del gobernador para impugnar el testamento de don Joaquín a favor de Marianne. El gobernador da su autorización, pero le advierte que si no puede probar lo que dice, se juega su cabeza.
Juan le dice a Sofía que no se casará con ella porque Bernardo mató a sus padres. Sarita y Jimena descubren que una pareja adoptará a una niña del orfanato y temen que sea la hija de Sofía.
Franco y Jimena adoptan a las tres niñas del orfanato para evitar que las separen de Sofía. Juan, Franco y Óscar le reclaman a Gabriela no decirles antes que Bernardo es el asesino de sus padres.

Fernando descubre que ya no forma parte del testamento de Gabriela y se molesta al saber que todo lo que ha hecho no ha funcionado. Sarita se niega a creer que su padre es un asesino y lo defiende aun sabiendo que puede perder a Franco.
El padre le advierte a Don Agustín que no debe seguir investigando a Fernando porque podría sufrir las consecuencias.
Gabriela le dice a Don Agustín que impugnará el testamento de Bernardo y volverá a ser la única heredera. Juan se niega a ayudar a Sofía a salvar la cosecha por culpa de Gabriela.

Eduardo comienza a sentir una gran atracción por Gaviota. Minerva le pide a Aarón que despida a Gaviota de la empresa. Minerva sospecha que Aarón le está siendo infiel con Pamela. Minerva cae de las escaleras deseando perder a su bebé.
Aarón teme que Minerva no pueda volver a embarazarse después de su accidente. Aarón se aprovecha de la falta de atención que Rodrigo tiene en Isadora para poder seducirla.
Minerva y Fedra idean un nuevo plan para evitar que Rodrigo se reencuentre con Gaviota. Aarón le ofrece a Gaviota ser la nueva gerente de las empresas Montalvo.

Pilar se decepciona de Rodrigo al saber que no asistió a la misa de Amador. Clara le cuenta a Gaviota los buenos momentos que vivió al lado de Amador. Rodrigo descubre que Gaviota es la secretaria de Aarón.
Gaviota le miente a Rodrigo diciéndole que ya no lo ama para poder lograr que se aleje de ella. Bruno enfurece al ver que Aarón está poniendo en riesgo el capital de la empresa.
Elena le confiesa a Héctor que tiene que poner distancia entre ellos, porque teme enamorarse de él; Rubí intenta hablar con Alejandro de lo sucedido con Sonia, pero él no la deja hablar del pasado.
El Conde le dice a Rubí, que ella terminará con él tarde o temprano; Maribel y Sofía le dicen a Alejandro que Rubí tuvo que ver con la muerte de Sonia y su mamá se lo confirma.
Los planes de Rubí y Alejandro se vienen abajo, cuando él le pregunta sobre la muerte de Sonia; La nana de Maribel, muere en su intento de hablar con Héctor, para contarle algunas cosas de Rubí.

Alejandro decide demandar a Rubí por la muerte de su esposa e hijo y quiere que pague por el crimen que cometió, más tarde Rubí es detenida. Arturo y Elisa hablan con Maribel para decirle que se van a casar.

Las pruebas presentadas no son suficientes para acusar a Rubí, el Conde agiliza los trámites y ella sale libre; Héctor recibe la demanda que Rubí levantó en su contra, mientras que Elena le dice a Rubí que Héctor terminará enamorándose de ella.
Carola le dice a Alejandra que venderá su parte del casino a Emir; Octavio le confiesa al gobernador que no quiere casarse con Doris.

On the eve of D-Day, American paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate the walls of a fortified church and destroy a radio transmitter. As the soldiers approach their target, they soon begin to realize that there's more going on in the Nazi-occupied village than a simple military operation. Making their way to an underground lab, the outnumbered men stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a vicious battle against an army of the undead.

For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova.

After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world.
In 2019 a mercenary (Djimon Hounsou) pursues two clones (Ewan McGregor, Scarlett Johansson) who escaped from a research facility after learning their true fate.

A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost.
Movie, Thriller, Drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure

Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them.

A cab driver realizes his current fare is a hit man that has been having him drive around from mark to mark until the last witness to a crime is dead. When the cabbie finally figures out the truth, he must prevent the assassin from wiping out his last witness without becoming the next in the professional killer's line of casualties.

After its boat capsizes, a group of migrants is rescued by rich Europeans who offer shelter on the island where they are vacationing. The miracle becomes a nightmare when the saviors reveal their true plan and turn into ruthless man hunters.

In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

The small town of Huntingburg is forced to evacuate when torrential rains bring rising floodwaters. The local sheriff and town residents, having been through this before, are all too familiar with the looting and petty thefts that take place in an abandoned town. What they are not aware of, however, is the planned heist of an armored car sent to transport the $3 million from local banks.

Frank Morris (Clint Eastwood), a hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz -- America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison. Morris quickly realizes the prison's dehumanizing effects and clashes with its cruel warden (Patrick McGoohan). Fed up with life at Alcatraz, Morris and two convict brothers (Fred Ward, Jack Thibeau) meticulously plan the unthinkable: an escape from the island.
Chaos ensues when a meteor hits the Earth carrying alien life forms that give new meaning to the term survival of the fittest.

Cone-headed extraterrestrials Beldar (Dan Aykroyd) and Prymaat (Jane Curtin) find themselves in New Jersey after a recon mission for their home planet of Remulak goes awry. Stranded, they are forced to live as typical suburban humans. Beldar gets a job, and daughter Connie (Michelle Burke) grows up to be a typical, if oddly shaped, teenager. When INS agents start investigating the family and Beldar receives sinister orders from Remulak, the Coneheads must decide where their allegiance lies.

Playful Pee-wee Herman (Paul Reubens) operates a fantastical farm with talking animals and hot-dog trees. One day, after a giant tornado hits, Pee-wee finds a circus has landed in his yard. He befriends the manager, Mace Montana (Kris Kristofferson), and develops a crush on a trapeze performer (Valeria Golino), even though he already has a fiancée (Penelope Ann Miller). Pee-wee tries to excite the town about the new circus, but most of the residents want it gone and harass Pee-wee because of it.
The misadventures of three ingenious orphans and the villainous actor Count Olaf who wants their enormous fortune.

A low-level Washington, D.C., public servant, Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), is thrust into the national spotlight when he's asked by Martin Geller (Dylan Baker), the head of the Democratic Party, to run for president after the party's presidential and vice-presidential nominees are killed in a plane crash. The odds are against Gilliam, mostly because he has a penchant for telling the truth about what is wrong with the country. Remarkably, his straight-talking style catches on with the public.

A cocky ad executive, Marcus (Eddie Murphy) has a reputation as a ladies' man. However, Marcus gets a taste of his own medicine when a merger finds him working under the beautiful Jacqueline (Robin Givens), who has a similarly cavalier attitude about romance. Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline.

In the wake of her mother's death in a mental institution, detective Rita Veder (Angela Bassett) is assigned to a baffling serial murder case. After examining the crime scene -- a corpse-filled ship found adrift at sea -- Rita meets Maximilian (Eddie Murphy), a smooth-talking Caribbean playboy determined to romance her. When Rita begins suffering from crippling hallucinations, she calls upon Dr. Zeko (Zakes Mokae), an occultist who suspects a vampire is on the loose.

In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. When gangster Bugsy Calhoune (Michael Lerner) learns that Sugar Ray's place is pulling in more money than his own establishment, the Petty Pat Club, he pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone (Danny Aiello) to close Club Sugar Ray down. Quick doesn't exactly help the situation when he falls for Calhoun's gun moll, Miss Dominique La Rue (Jasmine Guy).
Movie, Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Adventure, Thriller

Adapted from a comedy sketch on HBO's The Chris Rock Show, Pootie Tang (Lance Crouther) is the ultimate superhero. A cool-walking, smooth-talking lady's man, Pootie is a hero and a role model to all the kids of the neighborhood. Everybody looks up to Pootie except evil Dick Lecter (Robert Vaughn), CEO of Lecter Corp., a company that makes cigarettes, alcohol and fast food. Pootie shows cool determination and strength to prevail over Lecter and his minions.

Ralph Kramden (Cedric the Entertainer) drives a bus in New York City but dreams of something more. Unfortunately, none of Ralph's business ideas -- which often incorporate his best friend, Ed (Mike Epps) -- have panned out. Knowing their husbands will never get them out of the city, Ralph's wife, Alice (Gabrielle Union), and Ed's wife, Trixie (Regina Hall), pool their savings to purchase a house in the suburbs. But once the men find out about the secret stash, they might just blow it all.

Brown reflects on his rise to stardom by revealing personal stories about becoming a pop culture icon and his song "Bad Boy"; Bobby meets his match when he falls in love with singing sensation Whitney Houston and gives an inside look.

Accounts of an amphibious UFO in Indonesia; a mass abduction in Australia; a slew of deaths in Wales after a strange sighting; searching for an alien library with an astronaut and meeting a scientist hunting for an interdimensional portal.
Taking a look at strange crafts flying over power plants, airports and the Royal Palace in Sweden, a veteran with supposed UFO-related health issues and footage shown at a US congressional hearing.
Investigating reports of UFOs massed over the South China Sea, ancient carvings of alienlike humanoids, and Albert Einstein's secret 1947 visit to Roswell, New Mexico.
A look at a series of metal cubes seen spinning in the sky over Earth; exploring the origin of an angel-shaped apparition; China's interest in aliens; a metal alloy that may power UFOs; scareships.
A mysterious doorway on Mars; victims of a UFO in the Amazon; an alien party crasher at the Queen's Jubilee in London; animal mutilations in France; a video of otherworldly visitors to Turkey.

Fending off a swarm of aggressive UFOs with a U.S. warship; an alien voice takes over a British TV broadcast; an Australian teacher who was threatened after a UFO sighting at school; exploring who the Men in Black really are.
A new kind of alien; picking apart an abduction case in the UK; learning why NASA is investigating UFOs after decades of denial; looking at time travel.

Sinister shapes hover over Chicago and Ruwa, Zimbabwe; an Australian is fighting for his life after taking a blast from a mysterious object; a UFO appears to taunt a U.S. military fighter jet over the Bermuda Triangle.
A pilot records a fleet of glowing UFOs over the South China Sea that appear and disappear; 12,000-year-old carvings at Karahan Tepe depict humanoids with mysterious features.

Digging into a UFO crash caught on camera in Brazil; a close encounter of the Beatles kind; finding out if aliens shut down a nuclear missile launch site in Montana; looking at the shapes of UFOs and considering a link between ghosts and aliens.

The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone.

Los Angeles Police Department detective Russell Poole has spent years trying to solve his biggest case -- the murders of The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac Shakur -- but after two decades, the investigation remains open. Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why. In search of the truth, the two team up and unravel a growing web of institutional corruption and lies.

After serving 28 years in prison for accidentally killing the son of a crime boss, newly paroled gangster Val (Al Pacino) reunites with his former partners in crime, Doc (Christopher Walken) and Hirsch (Alan Arkin), for a night on the town. As the three men revisit old haunts, reflect on their glory days and try to make up for lost time, one wrestles with a terrible quandary: Doc has orders to kill Val, and time is running out for him to figure out a way out of his dilemma.
A robbery turns into a tense hostage situation when three gunmen hold up a diner the mob uses as a front.

Earl intends to protect his neighborhood while pursuing revenge for the death of his sister. He meets Keisha, a single mother who struggles to raise her son, and tries to build a future with her by leaving his past behind.
Intimate, unfiltered conversations with today's biggest stars, hosted by Speedy Morman.

Join Joe La Puma as he takes artists, athletes, and icons to the best sneaker stores across the U.S.

The Wash is an action-comedy starring Snoop Dogg and Dr. Dre. As mismatched roommates working at a car wash, they come together to rescue their boss (George Wallace) from a couple of first-time kidnappers. If they don't settle their differences and get Mr. Washington back, the good times at The Wash will soon come to an end.
A beautiful woman (Marie Avgeropoulos) helps a New York bicycle messenger (Taylor Lautner) who's in hot water with a group of gangsters.

Jake (Sean Faris) moves to Orlando, Fla., with his mother (Leslie Hope) and brother (Wyatt Smith). He feels like an outsider in his new school and frequently lets his temper flare out of control. But Jake wants to fit in, and he decides to go to a party with his classmate Baja (Amber Heard). There, Jake is pushed into a fight and humiliated. Another classmate (Evan Peters) sees what happened, and encourages Jake to visit martial arts trainer Jean Roqua (Djimon Hounsou).

Unable to pay back the $20,000 he owes the mob, small-time hustler Link (Antonio Fargas) instead gives up the identity of an undercover cop (Terry Carter) who happens to be dating his sister, Foxy Brown (Pam Grier). When gangsters later kill the cop, Foxy is quick to make the connection and swears vengeance. Posing as a prostitute, and with the help of a group of neighborhood vigilantes, she gradually tracks down the hit men, their Mafia bosses and her own brother.

At the forefront of early hip-hop culture, DJ Kenny Kirkland (Guy Davis), his B-boy brother, Lee (Robert Taylor), and graffiti artist Ramon (John Chardiet) all have hopes of showcasing their talents outside the confines of South Bronx, N.Y. When Tracy Carlson (Rae Dawn Chong), a composer and choreographer, runs into Kirkland and Lee at one of Manhattan's hottest nightclubs, she offers Lee an opportunity to perform on TV. However, the crew has a long way to go before achieving their dreams.
Carefree days come to an end when three Latino friends face personal crises in Los Angeles.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.
Sean's (Jason Brooks) estranged father returns; J.D. and Kekoa (Michael Bergin, Stacy Kamano) make wedding plans.

A plane crash in the ocean turns into real trouble after the rescue, when the contents of a suitcase wash ashore.
Mitch and Craig confront a killer when they volunteer to help Garner investigate a series of murders.
Eddie's life is endangered when he befriends a young woman who is being pursued by a pair of killers.

There is a killer in the crowd when people take cover at Baywatch headquarters during a vicious storm; Hobie is stuck at home with a female classmate.
Mitch and Craig (David Hasselhoff, Parker Stevenson) feud at a lifeguard reunion; Eddie (Billy Warlock) gets the deal of a lifetime on a new car. Guest stars: Dana Sparks, Tony Higgins.
Eddie and Shauni are trapped in a submerged armored car; Jill and Trevor team against an ex-boyfriend in a volleyball game.
A modern-day renaissance man and part-time lifeguard, J.D. Cort, appears on the scene and immediately causes trouble.

Eddie gets into gambling trouble; Hobie believes good grades are on the way because Mitch is dating the teacher.
A rookie lifeguard (Lance Wilson-White) suffers an untimely and mysterious death; Hobie (Brandon Call) takes in a runaway. With Billy Warlock.
Follow the trials and tribulations of North America's bears as they struggle to survive in an increasingly hostile world.

The conflict between black bear mothers Jeannie and Katie continue as Jeannie besieges Katie's two cubs in a tree; Brown bear mother Blondie and her three cubs make the most of carrion washed up by the sea.
Brown bear mum Blondie and her cubs were last seen fleeing from a pack of wolves. Have they survived? Both the black and polar bear families have trouble with marauding males.

Gordon Buchanan uses his skills as a wildlife cameraman to gain the trust of a white wolf family; as spring turns to summer, he becomes accepted by the pack, including mother Luna and her three newborn pups.
Gordon Buchanan reunites with his white wolf family as they try to raise their pups and prepare for winter; he walks with wolves as they hunt lemmings, muskox and hares and encounter a rival pack.

Gordon Buchanan's travels to the remote Canadian Arctic in search of wolves that have never seen people - wolves that have no fear of humans; using his skills as a wildlife cameraman Gordon begins to gain the trust of a white wolf family.
Investigating India's growing problem with tiger poaching; tiger scientist turned whistleblower, Raghu uncovers the scale of the problem.
How the world's biggest beasts overcome the challenges of their size.
Dr. Bryan Fry discovers there's a lot more to the Komodo dragon than meets the eye - from hidden venom glands to its secret origins.
Charting a year in the running of Highgrove, home to the Prince of Wales, who takes an active part in the management of the organic garden and estate.
The peregrine falcon is the fastest animal on Earth; but what does it take to be a high-speed record breaker?

David Attenborough chooses ten animals that he would most like to save from extinction.
The lives of cheetahs, leopards, servals, caracals and lions.

David Attenborough travels to the remote highlands of New Guinea and the rainforests of Australia to explore the world of the bowerbird, a creature which flaunts its charms, steals for its own purposes and indulges in spiteful acts.
Featuring the story of Rodrigo Medellin, who has dedicated his life to saving bats.

Delve into the adventures of first-time stoat mum Bandita as she raises her kits in a unique weasel wonderland, with over 50 hidden cameras; cameras capture a half-ounce orphaned least weasel called Twiz embarking on her journey back to the wild.
A film following the Tokitok pride of lions in Tanzania's breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater.

David Attenborough shares his passion for birds' eggs, from their ability to nurture new life, to their strength to withstand the weight of an incubating parent and their potential to allow a chick to break free.

Showcases how bears across the world have overcome the challenges of life, from finding food and raising cubs, to confronting rivals and habitat loss, all thanks to brains, brawn and amazing adaptability.
From the windswept tundra of Arctic Russia to the lava-spewing volcanoes of Hawaii, a great migration is underway.
In the heart of the Sahara Desert, a herd of elephants emerges from behind a wind-swept sand dune.
History of the craft movement; some of the best craft artists in America.

Nina Dobrev and Julianne Hough visit the Bon Appétit Test Kitchen; they sample six kinds of nuts from around the world, even pairing some with Nina and Julianne's own Fresh Vine Wine Chardonnay.
Sommelier André Mack is back to do what he does best: taste wine.

A mysterious woman gunslinger, Ellen (Sharon Stone), saunters into the town of Redemption looking for revenge. Her father was killed by the town's sadistic mayor, Herod (Gene Hackman), who is in the midst of organizing a quick-draw tournament. The lady enters, joining a cast of miscreants and outlaws for a brutal competition in which the loser dies. Among the competitors is "The Kid" (Leonardo DiCaprio), an upstart who has his own score to settle with Herod.

Colonel Harvey, a traveling salesman, arrives at Mayberry and captivates Aunt Bee, who buys Harvey's dubious elixir and invites him for dinner. When Andy and Barney find Aunt Bee clearly drunk, they analyze Harvey's elixir.
Malcolm Merriweather, an English tourist, passes by Mayberry on a bicycle; after causing a traffic accident, he agrees to work off the damages as Andy's personal valet.

Newlywed Benjamin Taber is in town with his bride when a bank robbery goes awry, and she disappears in a chaotic shootout. Determined to find her, Benjamin seeks out the help of crusty Quentin Leech, a bounty hunter who has his own reasons for wanting to catch the outlaws. As they follow the group's trail, they receive help from several unlikely sources, including Flora Mae Pepper, the owner of a brothel that doubles as a safe haven.

The Rev. Shay moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha, leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

In pre-Civil War Texas, naïve Karl Westover (Gary Busey) accidentally kills his brother-in-law, and heads to Mexico to escape the consequences. Along the way, he encounters Barbarosa (Willie Nelson), who is also on the run. Barbarosa teaches Karl survival skills for the desert — and how to rob. In their journey from Texas to Mexico and back again, the two men are captured by outlaw Angel Morales, and pursued by Don Braulio (Gilbert Roland), who wants Barbarosa dead.

Unaware that the Civil War has ended, Col. John Henry Thomas (John Wayne) successfully attacks a Confederate company led by James Langdon (Rock Hudson). With the remnants of Langdon's squadron fleeing to Mexico, Thomas and his adopted Native American son, Blue Boy (Roman Gabriel), gather a herd of horses and head for the border with their company, to sell them. After Langdon's caravan is captured by a Mexican general (Tony Aguilar), Thomas nobly sacrifices the horses to free them.
The infant subject of a child-custody dispute is found burned; a body is discovered in a home's crawlspace.
A cell phone and an ATM card lead to the apprehension of a rapist.

When 9-year-old Campfire Girl, Candy Rogers, turns up dead after selling mints door-to-door, Spokane detectives launch a dogged campaign to find her killer. One of the longest Cold Case investigations in Washington State history.
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.

In July 1970, the brutal murder of single mom Loretta Jones leaves 4-year-old Heidi Jones motherless; nearly 40 years later, Heidi vows to solve her mother's cold case and calls on an old high school friend to help her find justice for Loretta.
A Minnesota serial killer targets waitresses; a killer boasts of his crime to fellow prisoners.

A detective vows not to shave until he solves the murder of a young woman; investigators track down a killer with the help of DNA found on duct tape used on the victim.
A wiretapped conversation between a suspected killer and his sister cracks a 9-year-old murder case; a geologist finds human bones, solving the murder of a Virginia woman.

When Sherry Leighty goes missing in 1999, her family is left wondering how a dedicated mother of three could vanish without a trace; a decade later, the cold case heats up when Sherry's sister launches a social media campaign.

Robert Kraft (Richard Boone) inherits a familial post as the chairman of a small-town cemetery. The centerpiece of the cemetery office is a map of all the plots: White pins signify those claimed, black pins those occupied. When Robert accidentally puts a black pin in the just-purchased plots of a friend (Glenn Vernon) and his new wife, they die in a freak accident. Robert's uncle (Howard Smith) convinces him to make another switch, to see if it's coincidence or something more sinister.

During World War I, impoverished African-American father Frank Custer (Damien Leake) leaves his Southern family and heads to Chicago in search of work. After landing a job at one of the city's many slaughterhouses, he gets caught up in the heated debate over organized labor. Before long he emerges as a hypnotic leader, urging his peers to join the union, a move that puts him at odds with his best friend, Thomas (Ernest Rayford), who starts to question Frank's motivations for backing the union.

Since first donning a tattered fedora and a glove of eviscerating blades in 1984, Robert Englund has become a beloved horror icon. His portrayal of Freddy Krueger is without doubt a moment as visceral to the horror genre as Chaney's werewolf or Karloff's groundbreaking realization of Frankenstein's monster. However, few realize the depths of Englund's true power as a character actor away from the latex mask and iconic red and green jumper.

The true story of Pfc. Desmond T. Doss (Andrew Garfield), who won the Congressional Medal of Honor despite refusing to bear arms during WWII on religious grounds. Doss was drafted and ostracized by fellow soldiers for his pacifist stance but went on to earn respect and adoration for his bravery, selflessness and compassion after he risked his life -- without firing a shot -- to save 75 men in the Battle of Okinawa.

Pilot Brodie Torrance saves passengers from a lightning strike by making a risky landing on a war-torn island -- only to find that surviving the landing was just the beginning. When dangerous rebels take most of the passengers hostage, the only person Torrance can count on for help is Louis Gaspare, an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI.

Insurance salesman Michael MacCauley is on his daily commute home, which becomes anything but routine. After being contacted by a stranger, Michael is forced to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop. As he works against the clock to solve the puzzle, he realizes a plan is unfolding, and he is caught up in a criminal conspiracy that carries life and death stakes for everyone on the train.

On Dec. 7, 1941, Japanese forces launch a devastating attack on Pearl Harbor, the U.S. naval base in Hawaii. Six months later, the Battle of Midway commences on June 4, 1942, as the Japanese navy once again plans a strike against American ships in the Pacific. For the next three days, the U.S. Navy and a squad of brave fighter pilots engage the enemy in one of the most important and decisive battles of World War II.

Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.
