Nicole and Caffrey design a basement getaway for Sharon, Jason and their growing tweens, creating a space where they'll actually want to hang out. They'll also help real estate pro Haaris get his bungalow listing polished up in a competitive market.

Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for!

Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice.

Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.

Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.
Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines, where he indulges in an Indonesian dessert, the sweet Martabak, known as the "King of Street Food".

Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.

Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.
Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.
Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.
George Kalivas goes on a mission to set the record straight about where to find the best pies on the planet.
Pati is in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations - Puerto Vallarta. She gets an insider's tour of the best street food from one of the town's most acclaimed chefs, Thierry Boulet.
Two sisters made a little shack on the Rio Ramos into a must-visit restaurant known for one dish: cortadillo stew. Down the road, another restaurant uses traditional stews in their famous empalmes.

In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.
Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music. Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake.

Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco's capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city's most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city's best chefs, Fabian Delgado.

Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!
Acclaimed chef Michael Caines takes Fred to Burgundy to amazing places to eat serving the finest French country cooking and exquisite pâtisserie.

Jamie takes outdoor cooking to new heights with his Ultimate Barbecue Breakfast, a smoke-kissed Sesame Chicken Burger, his Veggie Barbecue Mezze offering an epic spread; and his Surf & Turf Mixed Grill is a perfect party crowd-pleaser!
Trick or treat! These affordable, spooky Halloween-spirited dishes are hard to beat!

At a loss when your pantry is empty? With these recipes, you can walk into any grocery store with only $7 and walk out with everything you need for an entire meal. Because yes, you can whip up a nutritious meal at an affordable price!

Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes that provide a perfect solution for busy life: a superfast, flavour-packed smoky noodle soup; the cleverest homemade bread in a pan; and a chicken & mushroom pie with a time-saving tip for perfect pastry.

Thomas (Dylan O'Brien), a teenager, arrives in a glade at the center of a giant labyrinth. Like the other youths dumped there before him, he has no memory of his previous life. Thomas quickly becomes part of the group and soon after demonstrates a unique perspective that scores him a promotion to Runner status -- those who patrol the always-changing maze to find an escape route. Together with Teresa (Kaya Scodelario), the only female, Thomas tries to convince his cohorts that he knows a way out.
Movie, Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Thriller, Mystery

Based on the popular video game, Milla Jovovich and Michelle Rodriguez star as the leaders of a commando team who must break into "the hive," a vast underground genetics laboratory operated by the powerful Umbrella Corporation. There, a deadly virus has been unleashed, killing the lab's personnel and resurrecting them as the evil Undead. The team has just three hours to shut down the lab's supercomputer and close the facility before the virus threatens to overrun the Earth.

A deadly virus from a secret Umbrella Corporation laboratory underneath Raccoon City is exposed to the world. Umbrella seals off the city to contain the virus, creating a ghost town where everyone trapped inside turns into a mutant zombie. Alice (Milla Jovovich), a survivor from Umbrella's secret lab, meets former Umbrella security officer Jill Valentine (Sienna Guillory) and mercenary Carlos Olivera (Oded Fehr). Together, they search for a scientist (Jared Harris) who might be able to help.
Movie, Horror, Action, Adventure, Thriller, Science fiction

As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full of a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.
An uptight professional (Ron Livingston) meets his lower-class biological parents for the first time.

Maximo gets the surprise of his life when his wealthy, 80-year-old wife dumps him for a younger car salesman. Forced out of his mansion, he must now move in with his estranged sister Sara and her nerdy but adorable son Hugo. Anxious to return to the lap of luxury, Maximo hatches a scheme to seduce a widowed billionaire and live the high life once again.
A teen (Chris Colfer), fated to meet an electrifying end, coerces his classmates into writing for a literary magazine he started to ensure admittance to his dream college.
With help from his coach (Efren Ramirez), a boy (Rico Rodriguez) tries to help his school's chess team reach the Texas state finals.

On the way to a tryout with the ⚾🐻 [MLB] Chicago Cubs, young baseball phenom Roy Hobbs (Robert Redford) is shot by the unstable Harriet Bird (Barbara Hershey). After 16 years, Hobbs returns to pro baseball as a rookie for the last-place New York Knights. Despite early arguments with his manager, Pop Fisher (Wilford Brimley), Hobbs becomes one of the best players in the league, and the Knights start winning. But this upsets the Judge (Robert Prosky), their owner, who wants Hobbs to lose games, not win.

The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity.

Peasant-born William Thatcher (Heath Ledger) begins a quest to change his stars, win the heart of an exceedingly fair maiden (Shanynn Sossamon) and rock his medieval world. With the help of friends (Mark Addy, Paul Bettany, Alan Tudyk), he faces the ultimate test of medieval gallantry -- tournament jousting -- and tries to discover if he has the mettle to become a legend.
Movie, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Romance, Historical drama

Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. Unhappy with the results, ruthless gangster Irina Vlaslov orders the men to pull off another job. One member of the team is Marcus Belmont (Anthony Mackie), a crooked cop who gets saddled with Chris Allen (Casey Affleck), his new but incorruptible police partner. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.

Terence McDonagh isn't doing so well. He has a nasty painkiller addiction, courtesy of an injury he sustained while rescuing a prisoner during Hurricane Katrina. Plus, there's his alcoholic father, boozy wife, and prostitute girlfriend. And, he's just been saddled with a rookie partner. Now Terence must pull himself back from the edge of insanity to investigate a series of murders that has the city on edge.

Fast-talking diamond dealer Kyle Miller (Nicolas Cage) and his wife, Sarah (Nicole Kidman), live the good life in a beautiful home surrounded by thick woods. Their dream life turns into a nightmare when violent thieves, led by Elias (Ben Mendelsohn), invade their home disguised as police officers. With Kyle and Sarah now frightened captives, Kyle knows he must use every negotiating trick in his book, for once Elias and his men get what they want, the Millers will likely be killed.
In the 1980s Los Angeles, antique dealer Eddie Dodson robs more than 60 banks and becomes known as the "Gentleman Bank Robber."

A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.
A retired veteran hunting in Allagash, Maine, discovers a dead woman with a duffel bag full of money. He soon finds himself in a web of deceit and murder.

As the heir and current marketing director for one of the nation's biggest gun manufacturers, Liberty Wallace (Linda Fiorentino) is indifferent to the atrocities made possible through her business and her CEO husband, Victor (Oliver Platt). On her way to see her actor lover, Liberty ends up chained to a food cart full of explosives -- all at the insistence of Joe (Wesley Snipes), a sniper whose young daughter was a victim of gun violence, and who now has Liberty in his sights.
Steven (Ryan Phillippe) and Shannon (Rachelle Lefevre) risk their lives to uncover the truth behind their newly adopted daughter's disappearance in a small town.

Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

After making a speech in Moscow vowing to never negotiate with terrorists, President James Marshall boards Air Force One with his family and advisers. When a group of terrorists led by Ivan Korshunov hijacks the flight, the President's principles are put to the test. Feigning escape, ex-soldier Marshall stows away in the aircraft and must race against time to rescue his family and everyone else on board.

Hazel Grace Lancaster, a 16-year-old cancer patient, meets and falls in love with Gus Waters, a similarly afflicted teen from her cancer support group. Hazel feels that Gus really understands her. They both share the same acerbic wit and a love of books, especially Grace's touchstone, "An Imperial Affliction" by Peter Van Houten. When Gus scores an invitation to meet the reclusive author, he and Hazel embark on the adventure of their brief lives.

When children's author Henry Roth (Billy Crudup) loses his longtime illustrator, his publisher sends him a new artist, Lucy (Mandy Moore). He is a tangle of neuroses and nastiness, and he does everything he can to alienate her, even though he must deliver his latest book in less than a month. Secretly Henry begins to fall in love with Lucy, and at the same time, her ex-boyfriend returns to try to win her back.
After saving the life of her favorite rock star (Chris Carmack), a teenager (Amanda Bynes) takes him to a nearby island and tells him that they are castaways.

When Lindsay gets the chance to sign up to the notoriously exclusive dating service Eternity, she clashes with Will, her first date. They mutually agree that the dating service is a complete bust and make a deal to get their money back.

Danny (Chris Pine) is a blind man who does not let his impairment get in the way of living his life to the fullest, except when it comes to love. Danny's brother (Eddie Kaye Thomas) sets him up on a series of blind dates, but all of them go disastrously wrong. Just when Danny is about to give up, he meets Leeza (Anjali Jay), a nurse who works for Danny's doctor. There is just one catch: Leeza, who is from India, is promised to another man.

After drag racing his vintage convertible around Palm Springs, Calif., a retired NASA test pilot loses his license. Forced to take public transportation, he meets Caroline and learns to navigate love and life again.
Emma, motivated by the prospect of an inheritance from her grandfather, agrees to tutor the talented violinist Ava Field. She is unaware that her grandfather is playing matchmaker from the grave.
Book-cover artist Lea pretends to be the elusive author of a hit romance novel that was secretly written by snobbish literary novelist Michael.

Zoey Ross gave up on love and her passion for wedding photography after her fiancé, Todd, left her at the altar five years ago. When a childhood friend insists that she be their wedding photographer, she reluctantly accepts and finds herself again.

Born with the snout of a pig, young Penelope Wilhern spends life a virtual prisoner in her home. Believing that the only way to break the curse is to marry one of her own kind, she meets a number of suitors, but all reject her. Two devious men, one with a grudge against the family, hire a man to pose as a suitor, but complications arise when he begins to fall in love with Penelope, and she makes a bid for freedom.
At the behest of his mother's ghost, an addict (Ryan Phillippe) returns to his Louisiana home, where he must confront an ex-lover (Anna Paquin) who is now married to his brother.

Best friends Grace (Selena Gomez) and Emma (Katie Cassidy) quit their waitress jobs in small-town Texas and head to Paris for a summer adventure, accompanied by Grace's stepsister, Meg (Leighton Meester). The prepackaged tour fails to meet their expectations, however, and soon their spirits sag. But, when Grace is mistaken for a British socialite named Cordelia, she and her companions head to Monte Carlo to enjoy a week of yacht parties and cute bachelors -- then the real Cordelia arrives.

Sarah is headed back to her hometown for Hanukkah with news of her engagement. Upon returning she finds out that her father had a heart attack and things have gotten out of hand.

When Casey and Henry find themselves celebrating their birthdays at the same restaurant, they make birthday wishes at the same time which are granted. However, they end up getting each other's wishes.

Judy (Jordana Beatty) has planned the most awesome summer ever and can't wait to have adventures with her best friends, Rocky and Amy. Then she finds out that Rocky is off to tame lions and that Amy is flying to Borneo with her mother to save a lost tribe. Judy is bummed to be left home with her rotten brother, Stink (Parris Mosteller), and her second-best friend, Frank Pearl. And, what's worse, her parents go to California and leave her with an aunt (Heather Graham) she's never even met.

In this animated musical, the villainous King Haggard (Christopher Lee) plots to destroy all the world's unicorns. When a young unicorn (Mia Farrow) learns that she's in danger and that she may soon be the last of her kind, she leaves the safety of her protected forest and enlists the help of Schmendrick (Alan Arkin), a gentle, albeit clumsy, sorcerer. Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

A comedic send-up of the grim circumstances of the Middle Ages as told through the story of King Arthur and framed by a modern-day murder investigation. When the mythical king of the Britons leads his knights on a quest for the Holy Grail, they face a wide array of horrors, including a persistent Black Knight, a three-headed giant, a cadre of shrubbery-challenged knights, the perilous Castle Anthrax, a killer rabbit, a house of virgins, and a handful of rude Frenchmen.

Imprisoned on a drug charge, mobster Jack DiNorscio refuses to testify against his former associates in the Lucchesi crime family. When an ambitious prosecutor brings him back to court, he decides to defend himself. Initially regarded with disbelief, his forceful presence and knowledge of the law turn the tide of the trial.
Determined to help at-risk youths avoid the mistakes he made, an ex-con (Cuba Gooding Jr.) forms a chess club to offer them an alternative to running with street gangs.

Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity.
Teenage Sarah (Jennifer Connelly) journeys through a maze to recover her baby brother (Toby Froud) from a goblin king (David Bowie).

Jen, raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.
A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers.

Once an architect, Frank Bannister (Michael J. Fox) now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives. As he tries to piece together the supernatural mystery of these killings, he falls in love with the wife (Trini Alvarado) of one of the victims and deals with a crazy FBI agent (Jeffrey Combs).

On an Arctic expedition, Stanley Shepard discovers Charlie, a Neanderthal man frozen in ice. With a team of scientists, Shepard revives Charlie and learns that he has been cryogenically suspended for 40,000 years. Stanley grows close to Charlie as he observes the man and learns about his prehistoric culture -- but when the media catches on to the discovery, Stanley must protect Charlie from fellow scientists who want to use his corpse for scientific research.

Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. A group of top scientists are hurriedly assembled in a bid to identify and contain the lethal stowaway. Based on the novel by Michael Crichton.

Poking around in a church cellar, a priest (Donald Pleasence) finds an otherworldly vial filled with slime. Frightened, he brings his discovery to a circle of top scholars and scientists, who eventually learn that the strange liquid is the essence of Satan. The slime then begins to seep out, turning some of the academics into zombified killers. As the possessed battle the survivors, student Kelly (Susan Blanchard) is infected by a large quantity of the liquid and becomes Satan personified.
Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

Traveling back in time isn't simple, as James Cole (Bruce Willis) learns the hard way. Imprisoned in the 2030s, James is recruited for a mission that will send him back to the 1990s. Once there, he's supposed to gather information about a nascent plague that's about to exterminate the vast majority of the world's population. But, aside from the manic Jeffrey (Brad Pitt), he gets little in the way of cooperation, not least from medical gatekeepers like Dr. Kathryn Railly (Madeleine Stowe).

With the millennium approaching, a series of disturbing signs suggests that Satan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has returned to Earth and is walking the streets of New York City. It seems that Satan needs to find a woman who will bear his child, as the time for the arrival of the anti-Christ draws near.

Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler (Milla Jovovich), a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

When the first outbreak of the Reaper virus hit Scotland, Eden Sinclair was one of the last to escape containment and had to leave her mother behind. Twenty-five years later, Maj. Eden Sinclair (Rhona Mitra) leads a team back into the hot zone to find a counteragent to the virus, which has re-emerged in London. She and her comrades wage a desperate battle for survival against feral survivors, as they try to prevent it from ushering in a new dark age.

Shawntay says Derrick refuses to provide, cheats, walks out often, and denies he's the father of their baby; he says he's an "alpha male" and expects to be treated accordingly.
Elizabeth says Dontavious is a lying, cheating momma's boy with a gambling problem; he says she is unappreciative, territorial and known for overreacting.
Ericka says her fiancé, Gary, is unreliable, and she believes he's crossing state lines for an affair; he says she isn't perfect herself and needs to adjust her expectations.
Shannon says Zachary is more interested in conspiracy theories than their future; she wants a ring, or she's gone.
Ashley says Dex has completely given up on himself and refuses to work, and she's tired of paying the bills.
Sonya says her husband, Eric, is an alcoholic who destroyed their family with infidelity; she wants a divorce, but he wants to keep his family together for the children.
April says Joshua is a sneaky male chauvinist who won't commit; he admits he has no interest in commitment and wants to explore a polygamous relationship.
Nikia says Kiadra steals from her and doesn't set boundaries with other women; Kiadra says she wants to save the relationship but blames Nikia's insecurities as the real issue.
Samantha says Bob needs to propose in six months, or she's done; he has a tight bond with her children and sees a future with her, but he will not be given an ultimatum on proposing.
Shanelle is tired of being belittled by Richard; he thinks she is cheating because she receives calls from other men.
Maria wants a divorce from Cesar because he's become too complacent; he says she has been inconsolable since her mother passed.
Keita says Teresa is a cheater with no ambition; Teresa refutes that she's the cheater, Keita is, and she says the DNA test requested by Keita on one of their kids is ridiculous.
Roselyn says David is too emotional and is addicted to seeking attention on social media; he says she blocked him on social media, and he believes she's hiding someone from him.
Doris says Marie refuses to show public affection, post their photos on social media or engage in certain intimate acts; Marie says this relationship is new, and she needs time.
Tatiana says her fiancé flirts with other women, and she even caught him sexting with someone else; Jaquoby says Tatiana's an angry drunk who picks fights with dangerous people.
Alexa says Jaqirah's insecurities are ruining what they have, and if things don't change, they're over; Jaqirah says Alexa hasn't been honest with her, and she demands the truth.
Kevin says Amanda, 17 years his senior, accuses him of wanting younger women; she catches him looking women up and down right in front of her while they're out in public.
Tania can't trust Darnell after he cheated with an ex; he admits to his mistakes and wants a fresh start with her but demands that she quit with the constant accusations.
Shaniece says Trey texts other women, she caught him on dating apps, and they haven't had sex in months; he argues that she is controlling and takes money without asking.
Darrell says Ravontis often disappears for hours and turns off her phone tracker; Ravontis says Darrell's controlling ways about where she goes and how she dresses are not OK.
Jay says their family is being torn apart by DJ's reckless cheating and his refusal to be honest; DJ responds that Jay's insecurities are the reason their relationship is in turmoil.
Ashley is done with Trevor's verbal abuse and has officially separated from him after he burned her personal items; Trevor wants to move back into the house and start new.
Aquila says Gideon's misogynistic views have her ready to leave this relationship; he is from Africa and has different beliefs about a woman's role.
Danni argues that Alex is financially irresponsible and has a dangerous eating disorder; Alex is suspicious of one of Danni's so-called "friends" and believes she's cheating.
Queen thinks Johnny cheated after he left their family; she wants to save her marriage but needs him to put her first; he says she is controlling and tracks his every move.
Vanitra says Benz gambled away their rent money and flirts with other women; he says he's made mistakes but wants to save his marriage for the sake of their 2-year-old daughter.
Amanda is calling off her engagement to Hunter because he cheated on her with her best friend; he wants a second chance and doesn't like the idea of co-parenting their son.
Porscha wants a baby with Angel but wants to do it the old-fashioned way: with a male friend; Angel is against it and believes Porscha wants a relationship with a man.
Dwayne says Yvonne disappears for hours, and he found explicit photos on her phone; he's certain she's up to no good; she is tired of being controlled and tracked by her fiancé.
Gabriela says her husband, Oscar, is a deadbeat drunk who refuses to work a full-time job and support her emotionally; he says she is immature and bad with money.
Leticia says her husband is a cheater after finding a condom wrapper in his car; Alfonzo says he's made mistakes in the past but desperately wants to save his marriage.
Joey says he's stuck in a relationship with a cheater and a gambling addict; Sherika says he wasn't honest about his condition, which has her feeling skeptical about their future.
Joey says he's stuck in a relationship with a cheater and a gambling addict; Sherika says he wasn't honest about his condition, which has her feeling skeptical about their future.
Jeremy says Beth's drug problem resulted in her lying, having affairs and neglecting her children; she wants to save her family and wants him to give her another chance.
Keona says Adrian rolled the dice and lost everything; she wants a divorce because he gambled away their life savings; he says he's desperate to save his marriage.

Shortly after buying a house with her fiancé, Brandi feels stuck with a cheater; Andy says she constantly accuses him of cheating when he's just spending time with family.
Laquitta says she's over Eddie tattooing nude women and overhearing his flirty phone calls; he says he's tired of her pulling up to his job site, expecting to catch him cheating.
Ashley says Marcus lies about his whereabouts and having a full-time job; he admits to his mistakes but says he doesn't get enough credit for what he does for their family.
Tashawna says Malcolm kept a devastating secret from her and didn't come clean about his double life until after she said "I do"; he says he wants to salvage his marriage.

Beth says Jeffrey is allergic to work, and she discovered he was at the strip club when he should've been watching their child; he says she refuses to help him get back on his feet.
Lolly has a feeling Charlie refuses to let her visit him at work because he's spending his lunchtime with another woman; he says she is the main reason for their problems.
Dayandra says she's fed up with David's partying and flirtatious behavior; he says he's still young and no one is going to stop him from enjoying alcohol.
Diamond claims Brit lives a double life and is a master manipulator; Brit wants to save their relationship but says Diamond's insecurities are the main cause of their issues.
Angel says she gave John an ultimatum to propose within six months, or she'll leave; John says he wants to save the relationship but refuses to be part of anyone's ultimatum.
Daniel says Nicole is a lying cheater with a drinking problem, and he's had enough; Nicole says Daniel is controlling and constantly gaslighting her.
Maya says Tatyana is an immature cheater with anger issues and a gambling problem; Tatyana says Maya constantly nags her and creates problems that just aren't there.
Sakarreon says her husband's alcohol use spiked during the pandemic, and she is ready to file for divorce and take the children; Anthony denies he has a drinking problem.
Patricia says Arthur is stingy with his money and prioritizes his motorcycle before her; Arthur says his wife is a shopaholic and doesn't trust her with a joint bank account.
Chantel has grown suspicious of Prince's loyalty and believes she's being used for a green card; Prince says he's tired of the accusations and wants to marry Chantel someday.

Dana says she has had enough of her boyfriend's relationships with other women; she says he uses his job as a music artist to inappropriately recruit women to be in his music videos; Bexter says he's always been professional.
Caprice says Kenneth cheated and got another woman pregnant, and she's not sure if she can forgive him; Kenneth claims Caprice neglected him, forcing him to cheat.
Heidi says David is addicted to gambling and strip clubs which has left their bank account drained along with her energy to stay with him; David believes Heidi is just insecure.
Tony says Sherita wants a lavish wedding, but he wants to use that money to buy a house; he urges her to have a courthouse wedding, but she wants all the bells and whistles.
Courtney is tired of David denying their child and wants to prove that he's the biological father to save their marriage; he says that if he's not the father, he wants a divorce.
Chantee says her boyfriend of the past six years is a cheater, a drunk and extremely irresponsible; Traevon says he is sick of her spying on him while he's out with co-workers.

A young girl is left alone in her house during a worldwide catastrophe and fearfully hides from a malevolent force that is stalking her. When her parents miraculously return, they try to settle back into normal life, but become increasingly concerned about something that has affected their daughter Stephanie.

Caught in a typhoon, a tugboat commanded by Robert Everton (Donald Sutherland) comes across a mysterious near-deserted ship. Excited to find a vessel that could be sold for as much as $30 million, Everton and his crew board and prepare to move the craft, despite the warnings of sole survivor Nadia Vinogradova (Joanna Pacula). When a malevolent alien presence begins killing off the crew, navigator Kit Foster (Jamie Lee Curtis) tries to convince the rest of them to leave before it's too late.
After moving to a vineyard with her family, a pregnant woman experiences horrifying visions.
In France, an American female attorney (A.J. Cook) defends a murder suspect who has a brutish appearance and a deadly secret.

A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.
A family tries to start over following a daughter's release from a mental health institution.
While obeying a "don't walk" sign, Herman gets hit by a car.
Eddie's school essay about his family prompts a visit from the principal.
The Munsters are invited to a masquerade dance party to meet the family of Marilyn's beau.
Lily and Herman find themselves the unwelcome targets of amorous advances made by their nosy neighbors; Grandpa's love potion affects the wrong people.
Herman is mistaken for a monster when he takes a walk in the local park.
Herman and Grandpa mistakenly think that Lily is pregnant.
Hysterical gas company workers inform their boss of the Munsters' existence.
Herman embarks on a crash diet after he is invited to an Army reunion and discovers he can't squeeze into his uniform.
Eddie's science project, a robot, malfunctions.
Herman attempts to earn money for Eddie's college education by moonlighting as a pro wrestler.
Herman's twin brother, a known con artist, visits the Munsters.
Grandpa writes to a matrimonial agency hoping to find a wife.
Bank robbers mistake Herman for the getaway driver.
Treating her insomnia, Grandpa puts Marilyn in a coma.
A national magazine's computers pick the Munsters as the Average American Family.
After clashing with the rest of the family, Grandpa feels unappreciated; he leaves home and performs a magic act at a local nightclub.
Policemen Slim (Bud Abbott) and Tubby (Lou Costello) go to London and meet a doctor (Boris Karloff) and his evil alter ego.

In the first of Bud Abbott and Lou Costello's horror vehicles for Universal Pictures, the inimitable comic duo star as railway baggage handlers in northern Florida. When a pair of crates belonging to a house of horrors museum are mishandled by Wilbur (Lou Costello), the museum's director, Mr. McDougal (Frank Ferguson), demands that they deliver them personally so that they can be inspected for insurance purposes, but Lou's friend Chick (Bud Abbott) has grave suspicions.
Two detective-school graduates (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) help a framed boxer who can make himself disappear.
A hotel detective (Bud Abbott) and bellhop (Lou Costello) find dead bodies and a fake swami (Boris Karloff).
Two guys stuck in Egypt follow a medallion to the crypt of Klaris.
Tras sufrir un golpe de estado, Terán huye de Los Pinos y contacta al Cabo. Él lo busca en su avión privado y le exige la libre entrada a sus gatilleros. Amado deduce el blanco de los árabes.
Los Casillas sorprenden a los árabes. Rescatan a Casasola y Maldonado y encierran al cabecilla. Impiden que un misil impacte en EE. UU. El Chema se adueña de las narcotienditas en México.
Después de hacer el amor por primera vez, Amado le promete a Diana que escaparán juntos; pero primero, debe ir a Tijuana. Ismael recibe a Laura maltratada y herida.
Cuando Esther sea gobernadora, jura que arrestará a su propia hija. Para evitarlo, le pide que mejor se entregue antes. Amado hará hasta lo imposible para que no se sepa la gravedad de Aurelio.
Diana le muestra a Amado Leal los millones de dólares que esconde, producto del narcotráfico. Le pide que administre sus recursos. Los Casillas tienen al Cabo en la mira: llega a Quintana Roo.
La DEA reparte diez millones de dólares por la captura de Aurelio Casillas y el Cabo; pero Ismael triplica la cifra y garantiza la lealtad al Señor de los Cielos. Esther combatirá al narco.
Leonardo reaparece en Playa del Carmen y confiesa que huyó de Sinaloa, donde vivía con el Chema Venegas, su padre. Amado negocia con Maldonado a cambio de información.
El cabo y los Casillas se enfrentan a balazos. Ismael somete a Milton Jiménez y le apunta a la cabeza. Maldonado burla la seguridad y desafía al árabe. El Chema va a por su hijo Leonardo.
Tras la aparición de Leonardo, los Casillas se preparan para enfrentar al Chema y piensan en el Rojo, como uno de los suyos. Debe decidir de qué lado se queda en esta guerra.
Aunque sus hombres le recomiendan mantenerse bajo perfil, el Chema decide ir a buscar a Leonardo. El Rojo se queda con los Casillas.
La casa en Tijuana ofrece las mejores condiciones para ocultar a Aurelio, por los túneles que tiene. Amado ordena a Diana que agilice la mudanza con los Casillas. Arrestan a Casasola.
Para ubicar a Casillas, el Chema somete a Corina, pero ella se resiste a ayudarlo. Valdés y el árabe tienen listo el proyectil para el ataque terrorista a EE. UU.
Con la familia Casillas ya instalada en Tijuana, Diana y Amado disfrutan de una noche sin precedentes: el amor crece y promete ser duradero. Aurelio, aún en coma, podría oír lo que los demás dicen.
Mientras Amado se prepara junto a todos sus hombres para detener el ataque terrorista a Estados Unidos, Aurelio se mueve inesperadamente, cuando reconoce la voz de Corina. Casasola miente.
Los árabes eliminan al espía de los Casillas. Amado descifra el mensaje del asesino, que le da claves del lugar del ataque terrorista, y lo amenaza de muerte.
Viva de milagro y huyendo de Baltasar Ojeda, la Doña llega a México y se une a Amado para enfrentarlo, poniendo en riesgo a los Casillas. El Chema se propone desenmascarar al doble de Aurelio.
Amado decide salir a un operativo con la Doña y Diana, pero ella decide no ir. Altagracia manipula a Águila Azul. Anaya comete otro crimen.
En medio del operativo para cazar y matar al enemigo que tienen en común, Altagracia seduce a Amado. Diana llama a su familia para advertirles que redoblen la seguridad.
Luego de dos emboscadas, explosiones y tiroteos, Amado enfrenta a Baltazar Ojeda. Milena besa a Rutila. Los Casillas secuestran a Anaya. El Pulque está feliz con Alba.
Después de muchos años, el Chema se reencuentra con Rutila y trata de seducirla. Diana espera el ataque de los colombianos y Amado decide asistirla en el operativo.
Por aire y por tierra, Amado y Diana defienden con armas y granadas el rancho Ahumada. Rutila le dice al Chema que debe consultar con la familia si quiere hacer un pacto que acabe con el Cabo.
La Doña lavará la fortuna de los Casillas a través de sus empresas constructoras. Diana, renuente, termina aceptando que trabaje para ellos. Carla denuncia a Terán y él manda a matarla.
Rutila debe convencer a su familia de que la alianza con el Chema es una buena idea. Además, pelea con Javi al saber que estuvo con su ex.
Para declararle la guerra a su enemigo en común, el Cabo, los Casillas pactan con el Chema. Javi estará al mando. La fiscal evita que la secuestren junto a Carla. Terán emprende su huida.
Castillo pone a Terán tras las rejas y le jura que pagará por todos sus crímenes, en especial, por el de Mayra, su novia. El Cabo embaraza a sus mujeres y ambas se niegan a tener los bebes.
Para proteger al cartel de Casillas, Amado se entrega a la justicia con la condición de ser procesado en México. Diana promete sacarlo de prisión. El Cabo huye.
Mientras Doña Alba lucha por revivir a Aurelio, los Casillas se apoderan de la ciudad para intentar liberar a Amado. Se alían con enemigos para enfrentar a los gobiernos de México y EE. UU.
El Gobierno tiene rodeados a los Casillas, pero ellos no son presa fácil y les muestran a quienes pretenden eliminarlos que son indestructibles. Pío trama su venganza contra Súper Javi.
Unos brujos condenan a una mujer a un destino feroz porque hizo cosas crueles para conservar su finca.
El sobrino de Paco, Jacobito, llega a pasar unos días con ellos porque está de vacaciones. Sin embargo, no deja a Paco estar a solas con su novia Mayra, y hasta duerme con ellos.

Tras la desaparición de Mia, su madre acude a las autoridades y Maya, la nueva integrante de la fiscalía, la ayuda a averiguar el paradero de su hija. Pau, Greg y Beto, los mejores amigos de Mia, comienzan una búsqueda por su propia cuenta.

A Idoia se le acaban los recursos para hacer frente a sus deudas, mientras el padre de Itzi le ofrece a su hija un contrato en el frontón del que es propietario. Chelo permanece en una silla de ruedas tras la paliza que le propinó su marido.
Descubre a los artistas del mes Uforia en entrevistas exclusivas con Christian Nodal, Fuerza Regida y Ela Taubert.
Elena Rose abre su corazón y habla sobre el proceso detrás de su nuevo álbum.
En una entrevista íntima, divertida y llena de verdades, Natti Natasha abre su corazón para hablar de su primer beso, la maternidad y cómo esa experiencia transformó su vida personal y profesional.

Yeri Mua abre su mundo más personal: sus rituales y limpias para proteger su energía, las malas experiencias que la han marcado en el amor, y cómo define a su tipo ideal. Además, revela cuáles son las red flags que no puede tolerar en una relación.
Una joven se enamora de un pianista de música clásica y tiene problemas con sus amigos de la alta sociedad.
Un amigo de Arturo es promovido a gerente general y Magda lo convence para que le dé un mejor puesto a Arturo, pero no saben que está involucrado en lavado de dinero.
La exnovia de Luis le pide que cuide a su hija durante el fin de semana, Pedro y Luis creen que la niña puede ser hija de alguno de ellos.
Vítor y Albertano acompañan a Lupita al mandado lo que no es una buena decisión porque tienen que enfrentarse al güero, mientras que doña Cuca y Nacho se quedan solos en casa.

Albertano se sube al metro a cantar para pedir dinero, se encuentra con el Vítor vendiendo discos piratas y se enoja con él porque quiere quitarle la clientela. Un policía les ordena a Albertano y al Vítor que se bajen.
Plácido está aterrado porque escuchó la leyenda de un monstruo en el trabajo. Mientras tanto, si Victoria no aprende a controlarse, la expulsarán de la escuela.
La familia prepara una despedida de soltera para Martina antes de la boda. Los hombres se ven obligados a asar al futuro marido, que llega con su sexy hija.
Un joven enamorado padece de diabetes. Su novia se escapa debido a los maltratos de su padre, pero el joven no descansará hasta encontrarla.
Una joven no puede superar la muerte de su prometido. La sobrina de la joven se mete a una página de internet para conseguirle novio a su tía, sin saber del peligro que se expone.
Socorro es maestra de primaria, pero padece una enfermedad que con el tiempo deteriorará su cuerpo. Sus hijos intentan cuidarla, pero ella podría volverse una carga.

Los padres de Aylin tienen un matrimonio complicado, lo que la hace pensar que el amor debe ser así. Averigua qué sucederá cuando Aylin comience una relación con Erick, un hombre mayor que ella. ¿Logrará cambiar su idea sobre el amor?

El hombre que reinventó la salsa revela la historia detrás de sus mayores éxitos, con anécdotas inéditas junto a las leyendas que han marcado su trayectoria. Inspirado por el legado de la Fania All-Stars, Sergio George comparte cómo transformó el sonido de la salsa y redefinió una nueva era en la música latina.
Alejandro le devuelve a Graciela las escrituras de su casa a cambio de que le permita cortejar a su hija. José Luis queda involucrado en la muerte de Bruno.
Graciela le prohíbe a Montserrat que siga saliendo con José Luis. Graciela prefiere aceptar que su hija se case con Alejandro a permitir su relación con el cabo.

Aurora está dispuesta a esperar a que Mariano se olvide de Teresa para poder ganarse su corazón. Juana está decidida a hacer el vestido de novia de Teresa. Luisa le deja en claro a Fernando que solo tratará con él temas de trabajo.

Fernando le confiesa a Luisa que le gusta, pero lo aleja por miedo a que solo juegue con ella. Juana comienza a extrañar a Cutberto. Mariano le reclama a Aurora el haberle ocultado que su papá es el director de la clínica y rechaza su apoyo.

Claudia le dice a Mariano que Ana Lucía está viva y que ella se lo puede demostrar. Ana Lucía le pide a Remedios que le cuente sobre la esposa de Santiago y ella le pide que se olvide de él y siga su vida.
Las chicas se alegran por el regreso de Joaquín a la escuela, pero Lety aún se siente mal porque él se niega a perdonarla y darle otra oportunidad. Místico descubre que Rodrigo está vivo.
Florencia se entera de que Damián se ha reconciliado con Alfonsina. Elisa enfrenta a Alfonsina para demostrarle que ni ella ni nadie impedirán que sea feliz. Gael consuela a Elisa.

Columba le agradece a Calixto por hackear la computadora de Leona para robar su presentación. Gael le confiesa a Leona que le recuerda a Marena Ramos. Leona conoce a Romeo y sospecha que puede ser su hijo.

Ramiro le cuenta a Mariano que Ana Lucía es amante de Marcelo y que Ana Leticia sabe todo. Orlando le dice a Evaristo que no quiere terminar en la cárcel por la muerte de Daniel y Maribel escucha todo. Mariano se presenta con Ana Lucía como su tío.
Místico trata de convencer a Rodrigo de confesarle a todos que está vivo, pero él se niega. La vida con Teresa no es como Lety lo imaginaba y comienza a sentirse incómoda de vivir con ella.
Horacio le confiesa al padre Guadalupe todos sus pecados. Damián decide casarse con Florencia.

Leona descubre que la engañaron sobre la muerte de su bebé y que en realidad tuvo dos hijos que le fueron robados. Para hacer justicia, decide vengarse de la familia de su primer amor, además de buscar y recuperar a sus hijos.
Graciela le pide dinero a Alejandro para pagar la hipoteca de su hacienda. Montserrat y José Luis se entregan a la pasión.
Tomás descubre que Alicia robó el millón de pesos que le falta a Conceptos; Ariel hace todo lo posible por rastrear el dinero y desenmascarar al culpable; Lety le ofrece su ayuda a su amigo.
Alicia intenta despedirse de Tomás y se arrepiente de haberlo lastimado; Aldo entrega Conceptos a sus verdaderos dueños.
Lety prepara todo para su boda con Fernando; Tomás y Alicia deciden reanudar su relación; la tan esperada boda de los protagonistas.
Lety se presenta a una entrevista de trabajo en Conceptos, una casa productora, para ser secretaria ejecutiva, pero compite con la bella pero inexperta Alicia.
Fernando y Marcia tienen conflictos por la contratación de Leticia, y Marcia le pide a Fernando una explicación; en el fondo, a Marcia le preocupa que Lety esté tan bien preparada.
Fernando les asigna a Lety y Alicia sus funciones en la empresa: Lety se encargará del papeleo y Alicia de las relaciones públicas.
Bajo las órdenes de Fernando, Simón le pide perdón a Lety por molestarla. Fernando regaña a Lety por dejar la agenda personal descuidada y le da indicaciones.
Fernando se entera de que López despide a Lety y decide ir a salvarla, por lo que se enfurece con Marcia y amenaza a López con despedirlo.
Román deja plantada a Lety, quien escucha que Fernando se casará con Marcia. Paula María y Jaimito van a la oficina. Simón le pide perdón a Lety.
Lety recibe y ordena la información de los ejecutivos de Conceptos, pero Alicia se lleva los créditos tras apropiarse del informe que realizó Lety.
Lety recibe el comentario de que Fernando es un don Juan, y la advertencia de que no se enamore. Ariel encuentra errores en la propuesta de Fernando para tener la presidencia.
Fernando le pide a Alicia elaborar un trabajo especial, pero ella no sabe cómo resolverlo. Lety trabaja fuertemente en el plan de trabajo de Fernando, pero lo pierde en el transporte público.

Alicia le dice a Fernando que no hizo el trabajo que le pidió. Cuco y Adriana descubren que el CD que encontraron es de Lety. Omar se niega a ayudar a Alicia a preparar el plan de negocios. Don Erasmo llega a Conceptos.
Lety tiene un malentendido con Fernando, y cree que la despidieron. Lola le reclama a Efrén por su pensión.
Fernando le pide a Lety acompañarlo a la junta con Ariel; Tomás le dice a don Erasmo que su hija es secretaria; Ariel se burla porque Leticia estará en la junta de ejecutivos.

Alicia necesita una cita con Ariel para celar a Omar. Paula María invita a Lety a salir con amigos. Fernando está en casa de Marcia, aburrido decide ir algún lugar a bailar, Marcia se queda. Lety y Fernando se encuentran en el antro y bailan juntos.
Fernando decide pasar la noche con Marcia en su apartamento; Don Erasmo reprende a Lety por salir sin permiso.
Marcia se niega a comunicar a Lety con Fernando porque está concursando en el hipódromo; Lety obliga a Simón a llevarla al club para hablar con Fernando de inmediato.
Alicia le cuenta a Marcia cómo la humillaron las otras secretarias y sobre el nombramiento de Lety; Marcia le reclama a Fernando por el ascenso de su secretaria.
Olarte le dice a Ariel que Fernando es capaz de maquillar el balance que presentará en la junta del comité; Ariel se le insinúa a Alicia y ella se molesta, pero igual lo usa para poner celoso a Omar.
El ingeniero Ortiz le dice a Olarte que Lety bloqueó el acceso a los archivos; la niña que iba a grabar el comercial se enferma, Lola aprovecha la oportunidad y le sugiere a Irma usar a Adrianita.

Lety no hace las copias de seguridad y la computadora se descompone, no hay forma de presentar el balance. El ingeniero Ortiz le comunica al Comité los problemas con la computadora de Lety. Ariel reprende a Lety por no tener respaldo de sus archivos.

El club casi descubre al responsable de lo sucedido con la computadora de Lety; Lety está más cerca de ser vicepresidenta financiera.

Omar deja a Paula María en un bar; un zapato de Lety se cae en una fuente; Ariel le pide a Alicia informarle todo lo que pase en Conceptos; Fernando le pide a Lety supervisar la compra de unas cámaras de video.

Marcia le da a Alicia un cheque para pagar la luz y el gas; Fernando le pide a Luigi usar otra cámara mientras llega la de cine, pero él se niega; Marcia se molesta porque Fernando autorizará la firma de Lety en los bancos.

Koichi sneaks into Rohan's house and finds Rohan drawing manga at an incredible speed; Rohan can't stop himself from drawing after reading about Koichi's experiences, and he attempts to take another page from Koichi by using Heaven's Door.

With some help from an outpost of renegade hackers, Warren and George hack Altura's defenses and discover Estes' secret plan.

In Upstate New York, a zombie baby proves to be an obstacle for a diverse group of survivors, as they head cross-country in hope of creating a cure for the living-dead condition.
When the survivors run out of fuel, they embark on a dangerous mission to replenish their source; in New Jersey, Cassandra's past comes back to haunt her.
In Philadelphia, a group of psychotic outlaws confronts the survivors and a connection exists between the two parties.
Soldier zombies in Washington, D.C.; Ten Thousand's mysterious past is revealed.
The survivors search for Warren's missing husband in Central Illinois; a zombie tornado threatens the group.
A utopian enclave may not be all it seems near Branson, Mo.; the group's encounter with a religious cult may cause drastic changes.
Still reeling from the events, the survivors come across a gun show that makes the zombie apocalypse look tame.
In Nebraska, a zombie tsunami engulfs the survivors and desperate measures must be taken to survive; Citizen Z gets a visitor.
When Mack tries to have a real date with Addy, he finds himself in a nightmare that reminds him of a certain Bill Murray film with déjà vu vibes.
Radioactive zombies aren't the only danger when the survivors visit a town in South Dakota on the brink of nuclear disaster.
An all-female commune in Utah is where the two groups of survivors reunite, but when someone winds up dead, the illusion of paradise is shattered.
Murphy learns more about his abilities when he is kidnapped by a group of outlaws trying to score OxyContin; drug enhanced zombies attack.
Citizen Z redeploys the survivors to meet with Murphy's doctor; but at the compound they uncover game-changing details about their mission and the origins of the zombie virus.
Everyone tries to escape the impending nuclear blast; Citizen Z battles thawed zombies and issues an air bounty for Murphy.

A victim of his own anger, the Kid (Prince) is a Minneapolis musician on the rise with his band, the Revolution, escaping a tumultuous home life through music. While trying to avoid making the same mistakes as his truculent father (Clarence Williams III), the Kid navigates the club scene and a rocky relationship with a captivating singer, Apollonia (Apollonia Kotero). But another musician, Morris (Morris Day), looks to steal the Kid's spotlight -- and his girl.
The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain."
News of a trust-fund beauty (Kristin Scott Thomas) inspires the pianist (Prince) at a hotel in Nice on the Riviera.
An engaged Philadelphia policeman (Mekhi Phifer) falls in love with a beautiful woman (Beyoncé Knowles) while dealing with a corrupt superior (Mos Def).
A man sues his estranged wife for unreturned property; she says they separated after he had an affair and fell in love with his mistress.

After a year of living with girlfriend Grace (Kerry Washington), Wade Walker (Craig Robinson) is eager to propose to her, but she's still reluctant to introduce him to her snobbish family. When Grace leaves for a gathering at her parents' swanky compound, he hatches a plan to crash the assemblage, charm her folks, and slip a ring on her finger. However, his scheme soon goes awry, and Wade realizes that his only chance of marrying her is a take-no-prisoners confrontation with her father.

A joyous reunion in small-town Georgia turns into an unexpected nightmare when Madea, Joe, Aunt Bam and other family members gather for an anniversary party that turns out to be a sham. Instead of fun and relaxation, Madea and the gang soon find themselves attending an elaborate funeral that doesn't quite go according to plan.

After draining his life savings to enter a team in the Rucker Classic street ball tournament in Harlem, Dax is dealt a series of setbacks, including losing his team to his longtime rival. Desperate to win the tournament and the cash prize, Dax stumbles upon the man, the myth, the legend Uncle Drew and convinces him to return to the court one more time. The two men embark on a road trip to round up Drew's old basketball squad and prove that a group of septuagenarians can still win the big one.

Waitresses at a Georgia restaurant, Nisi and Mickey, decide to fly to Los Angeles for a music-video audition in order to raise money for their dream project, a business that combines soul-food dining with a hair salon. Circumstances eventually find the Southern ladies on the estate of Mr. Blakemore, an elderly millionaire. Despite their vast cultural differences, Nisi and Mickey form close bonds with Blakemore and his butler.

Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater.
Fun DIY-projects, crafts, experience the joy of doing it yourself!
A fallen swordsman (Clive Owen) leads a small army against a sadistic ruler to avenge his dishonored master (Morgan Freeman).

Caius Martius, aka Coriolanus (Ralph Fiennes), is an arrogant and fearsome general who has built a career on protecting Rome from its enemies. Pushed by his ambitious mother (Vanessa Redgrave) to seek the position of consul, Coriolanus is at odds with the masses and unpopular with certain colleagues (James Nesbitt, Paul Jesson). When a riot results in his expulsion from Rome, Coriolanus seeks out his sworn enemy, Tullus Aufidius (Gerard Butler). Together, the pair vow to destroy the great city.
Shipwrecked in a strange land, marauding Vikings must battle a band of mercenaries after kidnapping the daughter of a Scottish king.

As the son of Zeus, king of the gods, and a mortal woman, Hercules (Kellan Lutz) is blessed with extraordinary strength. Caught in a forbidden love, Hercules is exiled by his stepfather, the king, and sold into slavery. The legendary strongman endures harrowing battles and death matches in the gladiators' arena, and must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom, overthrow its traitorous ruler and restore peace to the land.

The modern world holds many secrets, the most astounding being that witches still live among us. Centuries ago, Kaulder managed to slay the all-powerful Witch Queen, decimating her followers in the process. Before her death, she cursed the valiant warrior with her own immortality, separating him from his beloved wife and daughter in the afterlife. Her resurrection now threatens the survival of the human race as Kaulder, the only one of his kind remaining, faces her vengeful wrath.

In 1931, the Bondurant brothers of Franklin County, Va., run a multipurpose backwoods establishment that hides their true business, bootlegging. Middle brother Forrest (Tom Hardy) is the brain of the operation; older Howard (Jason Clarke) is the brawn, and younger Jack (Shia LaBeouf), the lookout. Though the local police have taken bribes and left the brothers alone, a violent war erupts when a sadistic lawman (Guy Pearce) from Chicago arrives and tries to shut down the Bondurants operation.

CIA agent Bill Pope (Ryan Reynolds) dies while traveling to a secret location to meet a hacker who can launch missiles at will. Desperate to find his whereabouts, officials turn to an experimental neurosurgeon who can transfer memories from one brain to another. The guinea pig for the procedure is Jerico Stewart (Kevin Costner), a violent and dangerous death-row inmate. Now gifted with Pope's skills and knowledge, Stewart must race against time to stop a sinister international conspiracy.
A former agent (Aaron Eckhart) of the CIA and his estranged daughter (Liana Liberato) go on the run after his employers target them for assassination.

James Reese (Jonathan Rhys Meyers) has a good job as an ambassador's aid in France, but his real passion is a side gig, working in a minor role in the CIA. He would love to be a full-fledged agent and can't believe his luck when he lands an assignment with Charlie Wax (John Travolta). Trigger-happy Charlie soon has James crying for his desk job, but when he learns that the same guys they're trying to catch are after him, James realizes that Charlie may be his only hope of survival.
A courier in London discovers that one of the packages she's transporting is a bomb.
A former MI6 agent teams up with a Ukrainian journalist to uncover the truth behind Russian covert operations.
A former MI5 agent (Peter Firth) investigates the disappearance of Harry Pearce (Kit Harington) when the operative is blamed for the escape of a ruthless terrorist (Elyes Gabel).
Frost's (David Jason) informant, a young mother, is murdered.
Frost links the death of a young drug addict to an intriguing case of blackmail involving a prominent doctor.
When an undercover officer is killed, Frost must force his colleagues to cooperate in the investigation.
Frost joins forces with Christine Moorhead during a raid on a dogfight in which a boy is killed.
The past begins catching up as copycat crimes convinces Superintendent Mullet that Frost's life is in danger.
Detective Inspector Jack Frost (David Jason) is teamed with the chief's nephew (Matt Bardock) to find a missing girl.
A girl disappears while delivering newspapers; a couple gets menacing phone calls.
A rapist is on the loose in Denton, and Frost employs Hazel Wallace to help catch him.
The main suspect in the disappearance of an 8-year-old is a secretive young man with Down syndrome.
Frost's (David Jason) search for the murderer of an animal rights activist leads to a snobbish art gallery.
In Mobile, a professor of economics is found shot dead outside his bedroom door when he doesn't show up for class.

A St. Louis man is shot in his apartment with only his girlfriend with him, but she claims she had nothing to do with it; Tulsa, Okla., detectives need the childhood friend of a shooting victim to tell the truth about the crime in front of her home.

In Georgia's Gwinnett County, a man is gunned down in the early morning on his front lawn, the engine of his truck still running behind him; Detective James Lawson unravels a tangled web of jealousy and betrayal in order to find his killer.
A young man is shot down while walking home and rumors swirl about who could have wanted him dead.
In Tulsa, Okla., a homeless man is beaten and stabbed to death, leading detectives to witnesses that live under the bridge where he was discovered.
In Tulsa, Oklahoma, a father of three is gunned down after an argument, and the instincts of veteran detective Jason White are put to the test.
In Tulsa, Okla., two brothers are shot down after checking on their night cleaning crew; detectives struggle to find a motive before the killer strikes again.

In Tulsa, Okla., a father of two is gunned down when an attempt to stand up for his cousin backfires; when an unidentified woman found shot and burned resembles a suspect in a recent home invasion, New Orleans detectives suspect a connection.
In Tulsa, Okla., detectives question whether a young woman's death was a tragic mistake or murder; in Mobile, Ala., the murder of a young father tests the bond between brothers.
Tulsa homicide detectives must find a possible victim by getting her killer to lead the way; a young Mobile man is found shot in a car minutes after another man gets ambushed.
In Atlanta, a young man comes home for lunch and winds up murdered when he catches a brazen thief in the act; an ongoing feud between two gang members in Tulsa, Okla., leads to a fateful encounter.

A mother is stabbed to death and detectives search for her missing son, who might be the only witness; Tulsa detectives look for a link between the murders of a pregnant woman and a young man at the same complex.
