Gordon (ALF) gets help from an unusual source when evil Larson Petty invades Melmac.
Gordon needs a baldness cure after Harry uses his hair to build a nest, but a visit to Madame Pokipsi for help does not go well.
Waking nightmares, bloodthirsty spirits, demonic forces, and vengeful poltergeists visit horror upon their victims in this anthology.
Vacationers think they've found the perfect place for a bachelor party, but a deadly, flesh-eating virus is waiting to infect them.
A wild animal attacks six grad students on a weekend hike in the woods. One by one, they become infected with an unknown virus that turns them into bloodthirsty creatures.
A young couple travel to a shabby Eastern European hospital for plastic surgery. Once there, things unravel into blood and violence.
A plane takes off during a snowstorm and soon reports both pilots are dead. As the passengers slowly die off, they wish they had never left the ground.
Survivors band together after an explosion at a military bioweapons plant turns most of their neighbors into flesh-eating zombies.
Hired as a live-in nurse, a seemingly sweet woman (Kristina Klebe) unleashes her dark side as she torments a Vietnam War veteran (Gene Jones) who has dementia.
Malevolent aliens interrupt five collegians' vacation at a remote woodland cabin.
Preteen girls face a night of terror when their obsession with a disturbing online game goes too far.
A teen and his best friend endure nonstop torment from bullies at school, but that soon changes when one discovers a bloodthirsty creature that resides in a country shed.
A murderous assailant traps three people (Alice Eve, Josh Peck, Brian Geraghty) in a small kiosk containing an automatic teller machine.

A man and his pregnant wife become trapped in their car when a storm buries them underneath layers of snow and ice. As supplies dwindle and temperatures plunge, the couple must battle the elements and hypothermia in a desperate fight for survival.
After Tyler finds a cache of disturbing images in his father's possession, he begins to suspect that the man he trusts most in the world may be responsible for a series of unsolved murders.

Maggie y Elijah aprenden nuevas tácticas de supervivencia de Negan. El grupo de Eugene quita a los caminantes para pagar sus multas. Yumiko hace una entrevista para un trabajo importante. Daryl descubre más sobre Leah.

Los Reapers defienden Meridian del asalto de una horda de zombis. Pope cree que Maggie es la responsable del ataque, y los habitantes de Alejandría tratan de proteger las defensas de la ciudad, destrozadas por una violenta tormenta.
Daryl, Maggie, Gabriel, Negan y Elijah luchan contra los Segadores por comida. Aaron debe sobrevivir a una tormenta.

Se desata un virus y una escalofriante masacre recorre las calles de Montevideo. Los enfermos se convierten en cazadores y solo calman su fiebre matando sin escrúpulos a quienes aún no están infectados.
Investigadores exploran eventos extraños en un barrio de Buenos Aires.

Manolo y Candela se instalan en el madrileño barrio de Malasaña, junto a sus tres hijos y el abuelo Fermín, provenientes de un pueblo. La familia llega a la capital en busca de prosperidad, pero no sospechan que en la casa que han comprado no están solos.
En Barcelona, un exorcista y su nieta adolescente expulsan demonios mientras tratan de eludir a miembros del culto que les acechan.

Alma y sus hijos son asesinados en el conflicto armado de Guatemala. Treinta años después, se entabla una demanda penal contra Enrique, un general retirado que supervisó el genocidio, pero al ser absuelto viene a por él un espíritu vengativo.
Wherever your destination, traveling local or far, indoor or outdoor, you can be sure AccuWeather Weekend always has you covered.
AccuWeather "Ask The Experts" goes beyond the forecast to give viewers the how and why about weather, space, and science.
A drug-treated schizophrenic (Baird Stafford) plagued by horrible nightmares escapes from the hospital and goes on a killing spree.
Hitler's money man leaves his son (Michael Caine) $4 billion for philanthropy and possibly neo-Nazis.

After a stint in prison for his first robbery attempt, during which he is badly abused, Daniel Morgan (Dennis Hopper) swears revenge on those who ruined his life. Like the outlaws of the American West, Morgan, aided by an aborigine sidekick named Billy (David Gulpilil), becomes a folk hero among the Australian people, while those in power begin to worry about the trouble he is stirring up. Soon Mad Dog Morgan is Public Enemy No. 1, but neither he nor Billy intends to go down easily.

The Civil War is over, and the South has fallen, but Col. Jonas (Joseph Cotten) has a plan to revive the Confederacy. He raids a Union Army detail and walks away with valuable treasure that he intends to put to use raising another rebel army. Jonas needs to keep the treasure safe during shipment, so he places it in a coffin and forces saloon girl Claire (Norma Bengell) to play widow. Claire is unwilling to do her part, however, and puts herself in danger by opposing the dangerous Jonas.
A kung-fu fighter avenges his relatives, slain by their gangster boss.

After his ship sinks, Andrew Braddock (Michael York) washes ashore on a tropical island owned by Dr. Moreau (Burt Lancaster). While waiting for a ship to return him to civilization, Braddock becomes disturbed by the strange creatures roaming the island, and at the same time falls for the lovely Maria (Barbara Carrera), who lives with Moreau. Soon Braddock discovers that the creatures are the results of Moreau's sinister experiments, and plots to escape before he himself becomes a victim.
Movie, Horror, Fantasy, Adventure, Romance, Science fiction
Shirley Yang returns to China in search of Professor Sun to rid herself of her erythema, but finds him trapped in the mysterious Long Ling cave.

While investigating a terrorist threat that goes online, Korean authorities discover that a suspect has recently boarded a flight bound for the United States. When a healthy passenger on the same plane suddenly dies, panic erupts both in-flight and on the ground. With steadily decreasing fuel and international refusals to offer aid, the captain and crew take unprecedented emergency measures to save the lives of all on board.

Detective K and his partner team up with a beautiful woman who has amnesia, and they discover vampire bite marks on bodies. As they investigate further, they begin to realize that the woman is somehow closely connected to the deaths.
Released from prison, a kung-fu expert tries to help the police find a vicious serial killer who targets martial-arts masters.
A former serial killer who has Alzheimer's disease must protect his beloved daughter from her psychotic boyfriend.
When his cover gets blown, a Hong Kong cop (Wu Jing) lands in a Thai prison where the warden (Zhang Jin) works with a criminal mastermind (Louis Koo) to harvest organs.
A motley squad of criminals and samurai undertakes a desperate defense of a fortress, their stand triggered by clashing interests of the Shibata clan.
After surviving a bloody raid targeting a secret Witch Program, a girl goes on the run from the assassins tasked with finding and silencing her.

Unable to remember anything about his life, a man begins regaining consciousness in a new body every 12 hours. Now, he must piece together his identity, all while evading attacks from pursuing agents and dangerous criminals alike.
Returning from imprisonment abroad, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons in ancient Korea.
A laborer moves to Shanghai to become rich, and has to use his kung fu skills to survive.
Examining possible evidence of 20th-century alien contact, including a 1942 aerial battle over Los Angeles and reports of a 1947 UFO crash in Roswell, N.M.
An ancient mountaintop fortress in Peru constructed with laser-like tools; temples at Vijayanagara, India harness cosmic energy; an acoustic chamber in Malta enables interplanetary communication.

Historical prophets may have had alien influences; there are some who believe that extraterrestrials have used intermediaries; they were used to transmit important moral, philosophical and artistic codes to humanity.
Questioning how humans learned to heal by exploring ancient possibilities involving the human body, breakthroughs in medicine and medical procedures.
Spiritual leaders known as shamans have healed, protected and advised people throughout history. Exploring the possibility that shamans communicated with extraterrestrials to influence mankind.
Messages embedded in sacred religious texts, as well as in the design and location of ancient monuments that may reveal the purpose behind human existence.
Scientists have found thousands of planets capable of supporting life; possibly answering the question whether human life is alone in the universe.
Theorists suggest that the iconic religious symbol of the cosmic egg demonstrates that human ancestors possessed a knowledge of the DNA double-helix spiral and human biological coding.

Archaeologists and anthropologists make discoveries that receive no notice because they don't fit into the accepted scientific paradigm, such as an ancient hammer found in Texas or elongated skulls found on nearly every continent.
A look at whether Area 51's notoriety acts as a cover-up for much bigger, top-secret extraterrestrial experiments taking place at multiple locations.

In numerous ancient cultures throughout the world, stories were told of ancestors that came to Earth from the Pleiades star cluster, but could new scientific findings reveal that humankind's true origins lie not on Earth but 400 light years away.
Counting down the world's top 10 alien encounters, from the first reported abduction event to mass UFO sightings over New York's Hudson Valley to an incident in ancient Rome.
Charlie gets jealous of Jennifer's much younger boyfriend; Patrick helps Lacey look sexy for her first modeling gig.
A riot begins at prison and Charlie is held hostage by his group. Lacey, Nolan and Ed throw Patrick a surprise birthday party, but he has to hide the news of the riot from Sam.
Charlie and Kate are ready to sleep with the right people to get funding for their sex study; Nolan's new online girlfriend turns out to be 10 years old.
Charlie tries to stop Kate from having sex with the executive in charge of funding their study; Charlie's dad tries to stop Lacey from throwing herself at a sleazy yoga instructor.
Charlie recruits Sean to help him throw the epic party of the century; Lacey inadvertently gets Ed hooked on drugs.
Charlie competes with Nolan for the attention of a hot grad student; Martin and Ed come up with a patriotic scam.
Charlie is forced to hire a new psychologist to replace Kate in his sex study; Jennifer and Lacey trick Sean.
Charlie sleeps with Jordan's hot AA sponsor who happens to be a recovering sex addict; Ed helps Patrick design an outfit for a full-figured woman.
Charlie receives an unusual payment when he brings a pimp into his therapy group; Sean and Michael get into a racial dating mishap.
Charlie gets a new patient in his therapy group who believes he's the devil; Jennifer and Sam take an interest in their new neighbors.
Charlie and Sean go to war when Charlie begins having casual sex with his ex; the therapy group helps to make Patrick unattractive so that he can find a new man.
Charlie inadvertently suggests that Lacey and Patrick pretend to date in order for her to get her inheritance.
Charlie wants a do-over with the woman he lost his virginity to; Lacey's parents pay a surprise visit.
Charlie is pursued by a hot reporter who wants to experience his sex study; Lacey tries to take advantage of Nolan's lingerie store employee discount.
Charlie's bad-girl patient gets sentenced to house arrest and moves in with Charlie; Sean tries to help Michael pick up women.
Charlie's Christmas plans with Sasha are derailed when Ed steals the baby Jesus from a Latino church.
Charlie seeks his prison group's help when his partying ways result in him getting arrested; Charlie's group searches for a new therapist.

Wayne pulls Charlie aside and explains that he is about to be transferred to a Texas prison. He proposes that Jordan gets engaged to him, which the prison board will view as a reason to keep him in California.

Jordan's twin sister is in town. Jordan tells Charlie that the two don't get along ever since her sister slept with her former fiancée. She asks Charlie to help mend the damage between them, but he winds up sleeping with the twin.
Charlie and Sean start a competition to see who can score first with a gorgeous woman; Patrick agrees to sing a song with Jordan at one of her A.A. meetings.
Charlie tries to use Jennifer to tempt his best party buddy when he becomes a priest; another man could ruin Lacey and Patrick's sham wedding plans.
Charlie falls for the sexy daughter of his father's warring neighbor; Sean offers to help Jordan with her research.
Charlie is in trouble when he finds out that a woman he had a one-night fling with is related to his supervisor.
Charlie hacks Jordan's online date rate account to give himself a great review in order to get a date with a hot woman.
Charlie is inspired to start a new clinic at the prison after Jordan wrecks their sex study; Lacey unknowingly moves into an apartment next door to Nolan.
Charlie keeps choosing sex over work; Jordan convinces his girlfriend to cut him off for six months; the guys in the support group give Lacey's apartment a makeover.
Charlie goes ballistic when a drunk Jordan makes out with a prisoner; Sean helps Patrick make an audition video for a designer reality show.
Charlie spends the night with Lacey to keep her from killing her ex-boyfriend; Jordan makes a big mistake while taking care of Sean while he is sick.
After sleeping with a prisoner's girlfriend, Charlie finds out the prisoner is being releases the next day.
A female cop makes Charlie's life a living hell after he breaks up with her; Jordan struggles to establish a casual sex relationship with Sean.
Charlie tries to keep Lacey from hooking up with an ex-con; Patrick looks for a way to avoid being the bad guy on his reality show.
Charlie surprises his therapy group by bringing all of their dysfunctional parents to one of the sessions.
Charlie tries to resist temptations from Sean's hot younger sister; Patrick and Lacey discover that they are dating the same man.
Problems arise when Charlie's girlfriend brings home a hot friend; Lacey uses Jordan's help to try and sell her eggs.
Charlie gets Sean fired from the strip club when he sleeps with a stripper.
Charlie makes a promise to an attractive reporter; it involves an interview with an extremely furious convict.
Charlie and Jordan have to share a hotel room to expose a shady couple's therapist; Nolan discovers that the African child he sponsored is all grown up and more successful than him.
Charlie sets up Sean with a hottie even though he knows Sean is seeing Jordan; Lacey pretends to be in a coma in her latest scam to make money.
Charlie lets his house become a halfway house for hookers.
After a concussion, Nick is advised to not go to bed for a few hours. To avoid all risks, he attempts to stay up all night.
When Suzanne's Mother comes to visit, she attacks Nick for being an inadequate husband, while hiding her true feelings of her own husband's inadequacy, until Suzanne and Terrence press her.
After a Guys' Night Out, Nick and his friends struggle to recollect the events that led to the disappearance of his wedding ring - and Kevin.
When Troy provokes a school bully, Kevin strikes up a friendship with his tormentor to avoid a beat down. However, Kevin is soon faced with a difficult decision.
Mr Peterson asks Nick to co-host his wife's charity walkathon, but Nick is soon put into an uncomfortable situation when he suspects that Mrs Peterson has stolen Marilyn's bracelet.
Lindsey and Kevin enter Nick into a Hand on a House contest, where finalists compete by seeing who can keep their hand on a house for the longest.
When a well-respected actor shadows Nick to prepare for an upcoming role as an anchor, but his methods turn out to be much more invasive that Nick had expected.
Nick attempts to have a night out with Lindsey, but when all she wants to do is to follow around a young celebrity DJ, Nick tries to teach her how a man should really treat her the way she deserves.
When Nick happens upon an old college pal, the unexpected meeting gives rise to a business plan that involves a sports star and an energy drink. The results, however, are not so bubbly.
Nick needs a new van for work, but Suzanne worries they are already too much in debt and cannot afford to buy a new one. It turns out Suzanne has some credit issues she has not revealed to Nick.
When Nick is invited to play in a celebrity golf tournament at Walt Disney World, Suzanne is disappointed she has to miss the family's first holiday.
Lindsey auditions to dance in a P-Nut music video, but considers quitting when she discovers that the choreographer is a drill sergeant and the other dancers are far more experienced.
Suzanne suspects Nick has a kid from a past relationship when she meets Kevin's new friend Nathan. He does everything Nick likes, eats and wears, and his mother is an old fling of Nick's.

Nick attempts to make a profit off an expensive set of African masks that Kevin bought at a yard sale, but instead, he becomes the victim of a larger scam. Lindsey receives advice about her upcoming date with her crush.
Suzanne gets caught dancing on a video that soon becomes a huge viral hit. Marilyn decides Lindsey needs to learn how to cook soul food.
Romantic complications ensue when Nick helps a shy colleague improve his love life. Meanwhile, a pinkeye epidemic keeps Lindsey away from school.
Lindsey makes a reality show about her family, but she thinks they are too boring - until Kevin finds Suzanne's gun in her bedroom and shows it to Troy, bringing real danger to the household.
When Suzanne crashes a night with Nick and his boys, Nick decides he needs to pay her back by showing up for spa treatments with Suzanne and her girlfriends to show her what it is like.
After Nick gets pocket-dialled by Suzanne and overhears her telling Gigi something personal, he gets back at Suzanne by fake pocket-dialling her.
When the house sitters next door begin acting irresponsibly, Nick and Suzanne question if they are being played for fools.
Nick refuses to give Lindsey money for a concert, so Lindsey resorts to stealing sixty dollars from Gigi's purse - but when Gigi discovers the missing money, she blames Kevin for the theft.
When a new buxom woman gets hired at the station, Nick's career is threatened. Suzanne takes matters into her own hands to save her husband's job.
Kevin's new career as a child actor quickly hits the skids when his big break causes him to get an even bigger head.
While speaking before Kevin's class for Career Day, Nick confuses the students by implying that building connections is more important than studying hard and getting good grades.
When the entire Kingston-Persons's clan plus guests end up at the house for a pot-luck Thanksgiving, Suzanne has to scramble to find the one item she was in charge of - the turkey.
Nick struggles to prove himself when he is promoted to co-host alongside the lazy, arrogant Brick Street.
Suzanne begins to force everyone in the family to tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.
Suzanne is tired of being the bad cop and Nick being the good cop with the kids, so they decide to switch places.
When Nick's new field producer, Sam, turns out to be female, Suzanne is convinced she is trying to steal her man, a suggestion Nick thinks is absurd until Sam actually makes a move on him.
Suzanne meets a relationship expert and becomes convinced that she and Nick are having compatibility issues.
Suzanne is upset when Marilyn gives her an ugly bracelet as a present, but things get even uglier when Nick sees it and realizes he bought it for Marilyn and that she's re-gifted.
Nick's identity is stolen; Suzanne takes a week off to attend a wedding; Marilyn shares a life lesson.
Suzanne wants to have a formal portrait of the family taken, but trying to pull everyone together proves to be impossible.
When Nick gets a doctors report that he has high blood pressure, Suzanne does everything she can to make sure his stress levels stay low.
After balking at the high price of a purse Suzanne loves, Nick thinks again and tries to buy it as a gift - but Suzanne has already secretly bought the last purse for herself.
Nick discovers Suzanne's wedding ring is not actually real and sets out to have a real ring made before she learns the truth, while Suzanne thinks she has lost her wedding ring forever.
Kevin is a big football fan, but Nick does not understand the appeal. Suzanne is frustrated by Lindsey's lack of communication and creates a fake Facebook account to learn what is going on.
Lindsey has a new crush and Gigi has a new boyfriend, but when certain secrets cannot be kept, a web of misinformation nearly ruins both situations.
Nick's boxing match party unexpectedly takes over the family room on the same night Suzanne's book group is meeting in the living room.
While hosting an awards ceremony, Nick gets laughs by making Suzanne the butt of his jokes, but finds he cannot stand the heat when Suzanne turns the tables and starts making fun of him in public.

Nick goes to watch a game with friends at a sports bar known to have sexy female waitresses. The kids want a larger allowance, but they are not willing to do more chores in return for a higher payout.
When the Kingston-Persons decide to have a game night, all bets are off, as unlikely friends are drawn to one another when paired together for games.
When Nick lands on a porn website due to a spelling error, a co-worker takes it the wrong way, forcing KAWT employees to undergo sensitivity training.
When Suzanne gets roped into a committee at Kevin's school, where the other mums are mean to her, Nick volunteers to fill in on her behalf, making things awkward when the ladies love him.
The entire family plays pranks on one another. However, when the family ignores Nick's choking because they think it is another prank, Nick has a near-death experience and embraces his Zen side.
When Nick points out that Suzanne has issues letting go of controlling everything, Suzanne lets everything go. The family realises they need Suzanne's ways to run a successful household.
Using her mother's credit card, Lindsey gets help from Nick in ordering a Michelle Obama jumper online. Kevin pretends to be sick to pull off a scam to get a signed A-Rod jersey.
Nick helps out Willie Mays, a homeless man with a beautiful voice, by getting him a job at KAWT, but Willie takes advantage of his new job.
Lindsey gets high when her friend gives her a drug and learns a hard lesson.
Nick says he is too tired for marital relations one night, leading Suzanne to speculate and have major concerns that something is not right in their relationship.

When Suzanne wants a real honeymoon, Nick tries to plan an extravagant surprise, but despite his best efforts to create something romantic, instead misleads Suzanne into thinking he is cheating on her.
Suzanne and Nick go on a People's Court-type TV show when Nick lies about having spent a gift card Suzanne gave him, which she finds and spends on herself, calling him on his lie.
Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, her friend Danielle and husband Steve. However, the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.
Nick and Suzanne stop talking to each other after Suzanne gets upset with Nick for his attempts to fix her problems without listening to her.
Nick agrees to go to a Public Enemy concert on the same night as his proposal-versary with Suzanne, who is none too pleased. The children star in internet videos wearing superhero costumes.
When Suzanne is overly protective teaching Lindsey how to drive, Nick takes over and makes Lindsey feel confident, until she scratches Suzanne's car and chooses to lie about the incident.
When the family oversleeps on the morning Lindsey is set to sing the National Anthem at a baseball game, it is all hands on deck just to make it to out of the house on time.
Nick wants Lindsey and Kevin to give back to the community, so they select a charity they find online. But when the charity keeps asking for more money, Nick has to get to the bottom of it.
When Nick inadvertently insults Harold Bradley (a KAWT employee who has been around forever) on-air, he is forced to do damage control.
Yi-jung is waiting outside for Eun-jae, excited to see her -- until he listens in on her phone conversation; from her words, it sounds like a call to a boyfriend.
Jun-pyo begs for Jan Di to advise him not to get married.
Jun-pyo tells Jan Di that he'll protect her, but to Jun-pyo's surprise, she says that she does not want to be cosseted or taken care of.
Perhaps feeling it's time to expose one truth, Mr. Jung leads Jun-hee to the unknown patient's bedside; at the sight of her father, Jun-hee breaks down.
Jun-pyo asks Yumi to make the lunchbox once more, confirming that Yumi had taken credit for her lunch.
Just being rich isn't enough to endure the teen oppression at Shinhwa -- loners are often marked as targets by the bored über-clique called F4.
A wicked rumor is spread on the Internet that a second-year student at Shinhwa High School is pregnant.
Not too eager to watch Jan Di dancing with one of his best friends, Jun Pyo exits the ballroom and ends up taking out his frustrations by the poolside.
Making a rash choice, Jan Di tells her mother she has to go somewhere and runs off, heading toward Namsan Tower.
Investigating the murder of Sihui Fang, a 45-year-old Chinese immigrant pursuing the American dream.
Jan Di's bike is set ablaze while she is attacked with water balloons and blasted with a fire extinguisher.
A psychic foresees that Jan Di will be losing something significant.
Jun Pyo intends to expel his best friend and Jan Di out of Shinhwa High School -- and out of F4.
Jan Di dashes to the hospital after being informed that Jun Pyo had been in an accident.
Yi-jung gets a frantic call from his mother threatening to commit suicide because of his father.
Yi Jung's mother frantically calls him threatening to commit suicide.
A note indicates that class has been moved to the science lab. The lab is unoccupied, but Jan Di waits, not realizing that the room is filling with fumes.
Jan Di's father gets kidnapped by loan sharks, which inevitably forces Jan Di's mother to swallow her pride and plead for Madam Kang's help.
The F4 guys have moved on to college while Jan Di has entered her senior year of high school. She has not heard from Jun Pyo since he left.

When a sheik (Jamie Farr) decides to sponsor a cross-country race in hope of winning, racer J.J. McClure (Burt Reynolds) enters the competition along with his friend Victor (Dom DeLuise). They aspire to claim the $1 million prize and pick up two women on the way. Meanwhile, the sheik helps Jamie Blake (Dean Martin) and Morris Fenderbaum (Sammy Davis Jr.) with an angry mob boss. But when the sheik is kidnapped, the contestants must come together to help him.
A hapless New Yorker's (Griffin Dunne) rich future father-in-law orders him to escort a bleached blonde (Madonna) out of town.

A big-budget movie crew descends upon a quaint New England village, sowing a bumper crop of corruption, vanity and greed in David Mamet's "State and Main"; in the days that elapse before the cameras finally roll, money will change hands, careers will be jeopardized and love will blossom in the small-town soil.

On his way to Vienna, American Jesse meets Celine, a student returning to Paris. After long conversations forge a surprising connection between them, Jesse convinces Celine to get off the train with him in Vienna. Since his flight to the U.S. departs the next morning, and he has no money for lodging, they wander the city together, taking in the experiences of Vienna and each other. As the night progresses, their bond makes separating in the morning a difficult choice.

Small-town astronomer Sam (Matthew Broderick) is devastated when his fiancée, Linda (Kelly Preston), leaves him for French chef Anton Depeaux (Tcheky Karyo) during an out-of-town vacation. Obsessed, Sam follows her to New York City and moves in across the street from Linda and Anton's apartment, where he spies on them and records their lives. One day he is joined by Maggie (Meg Ryan), Anton's equally vengeful ex-girlfriend, and the two plot to break up the new couple.

Billy Crystal stars as Sammy, an agitated agent lost in the forest of the modern world, who happens upon a gentle giant with a tall talent for friendship named Max (Gheorghe Muresan). And while Max's life as a giant is no fairy tale, his heartwarming, hilarious adventures with Sammy prove that wishes really can come true.

In the small town of Gatlin, S.C., teenage Ethan Wate sees his static world shaken by the arrival of Lena Duchannes, the niece of town patriarch Macon Ravenwood. Immediately, Ethan feels drawn to Lena, even though destruction seems to surround her, and she has supernatural powers that are beyond her control. Worse still, a curse looms for Lena at the approach of her 16th birthday -- a time when the forces of either light or dark will claim her.

This "Lethal Weapon" spoof follows Los Angeles police officers Wes Luger (Samuel L. Jackson) and Jack Colt (Emilio Estevez) as they investigate the killing of fellow officer Sgt. Billy York (Whoopi Goldberg). On the strength of tips from stool pigeons like Becker (Jon Lovitz), Wes and Jack learn that the murder is linked to a plan by criminals Gen. Curtis Mortars (William Shatner) and Jigsaw (Tim Curry) to lace snack foods with hard drugs. They must stop the plot before it begins causing harm.

Jack Hartounian (Jackie Mason), a boorish but good-hearted real estate tycoon, applies for membership at a snooty country club, but is blackballed by the old-money WASPs, led by Chandler Young (Robert Stack). As revenge, he simply buys the club outright and turns it into a garish amusement park. Chandler wants to win the property back by challenging Jack to a golf match, but he hedges his bets by hiring deranged mercenary Tom Everett (Dan Aykroyd) to eliminate his competition.

After graduating from high school, art school hopeful Hoops McCann (John Cusack) struggles to complete his application to the Rhode Island School of Design. Resigning himself to a summer of boredom, McCann agrees to go along with his best friend, George Calamari (Joel Murray), on a family trip to Nantucket, Mass. But, after McCann and Calamari meet rocker-in-distress Cassandra (Demi Moore), it suddenly looks like it's going to be "one crazy summer."

For years, screenwriting team Richard Babson (Burt Reynolds) and Paula McCullen (Goldie Hawn) have built a successful Hollywood career while managing to live harmoniously together. After finishing their latest script, Babson uses the euphoria to convince McCullen to take the leap into marriage. However, when the newlywed couple travels back east to meet their respective in-laws, the pitfalls of marriage begin to surface. Unprepared, Babson and McCullen struggle with the changing dynamics.

When director David Merrill returns to the United States from Paris, he is called before the House Un-American Activities Committee. Though he is not a communist, he refuses to cooperate in order to protect his friend, screenwriter Bunny Baxter. Merrill faces repercussions and is blacklisted. Already on rocky terms with his wife and unable to work in film, theater or advertising, Merrill starts to waver in his principles.

New York City cabbie Jerry Fletcher (Mel Gibson) is an expert on paranoid conspiracy theories. He is also infatuated with government lawyer Alice Sutton (Julia Roberts), who permits his attention because he once rescued her from a mugging. However, when Jerry is captured and put through psychotic tests by Dr. Jonas (Patrick Stewart), he realizes there is an actual conspiracy. After escaping, Jerry enlists Alice's help, but she wonders whether he has uncovered a real threat or is just insane.
Una mujer moribunda intenta reconciliarse con su severo padre para que su hija ilegítima pueda vivir en un lugar seguro.
La guía de Jonathan ayuda en una conexión amorosa entre Diana, la prima de Mark, y Scotty, un divertido e interesante abogado con tetraplejía.
Jonathan decide hacerse pasar por un hombre millonario, despiadado y soberbio, y por un mendigo amable al que le queda poco tiempo de vida.
Jonathan y Mark le dan una lección a Laurie, una joven actriz cuya fama la está convirtiendo en una mala persona, afectando a su familia y robándole su infancia.
Jonathan debe reunir a los vecinos de Helen para que se unan y ayuden a salvar sus casas de unos promotores inmobiliarios que quieren desalojarlos.

Harry, todavía en duelo por la pérdida de su esposa, es puesto en un hogar de ancianos, pero su visión de la vida cambia cuando tiene la oportunidad de cumplir el mayor deseo de su esposa: visitar Hollywood.

La hija de un entrenador de caballos y el hijo de un ranchero se conocen en un entrenamiento y nace una atracción entre ellos. Jonathan y Mark tienen que actuar de cupido para unirlos, a pesar de que él ya está comprometido.
Garth y Lizzy se fugan juntos y se casan. Ella descubre que tiene cáncer, pero no quiere contárselo a Garth hasta no saber sus posibilidades de sobrevivir.
Como consejeros en un campamento para jóvenes con cáncer, Jonathan y Mark ayudan a un ex atleta adolescente con su ira y a un niño cuya madre es sobreprotectora.
Jonathan trata de que Miki, el negligente padre de Jason, se acerque un poco más a su hijo, pero él vive inmerso en su trabajo, evitando el dolor de la enfermedad del joven.
Mark pide que Jonathan se convierta en policía. Su deseo es concedido, y Jonathan se convierte en humano para experimentar las dificultades que conlleva ese trabajo.

Brian encuentra a su esposa con su primo; Janyce encuentra a su novio disfrutando de un almuerzo romántico.
El esposo de Elena tiene un gusto por lo dulce de una joven mujer apetitosa; la novia de Brandon se mantiene tranquila en los brazos de otro hombre.
El novio de Beverly vuelve con un viejo amor; LaToya disfruta de todo tipo de mujeres.
Sylvia Waters descubre a su marido cortejando a otra. Más adelante, Rita Stout descubre al padre de su bebé endulzándole la oreja a otra.
La novia de Andrew ha posado sus ojos en otro hombre; los celos del novio de Tiffany podrían estar cubriendo su propia infidelidad.
Gracias a Cheaters, Eve Cullen descubre a su novio buscándole reemplazo. Más adelante, María Hernández pilla a su novio cortejando a otra.
La novia de Allan se debate entre el amor que ella tiene y el amor que perdió; el esposo de Ramonda ajetrea a una mujer mucho más joven.
Jason averigua que su novia está viéndose con otro hombre; Sebastián descubre a dónde va su novio por las noches.
KJ descubre que su esposo ha sido un chico malo; Brittany encuentra a su novio engañándola con otra mujer.
El esposo de Thelma ha atado una nueva potra; el esposo de Lilly mezcla el negocio con placer.
Jay Ridgeway descubre las infidelidades de su esposa. Tyra Dennison se entera de que a su novio le gusta comer postre en el almuerzo.
Richard descubre la verdad tras los retrasos de su novia. Chastity se entera de que su esposa es infiel.
Rooster descubre a su mejor amigo besándose con su pareja. Al novio de Machell le gusta la pasante.
Jennifer encuentra a su prometido con otra mujer. El novio de Antonia se ha estado comportando mal, y ha estado yendo con otras mujeres.
El esposo de Gaby se divierte con una mujer más joven; Kiesha descubre que el padre de sus niños ha estado disfrutando de un estilo de vida de soltero.
Melody encuentra a su novio riendo con una audiencia exclusiva; Nicole descubre que su novio está teniendo favores de un miembro de la familia.
Ryan descubre que su esposa está hallando maneras poco ortodoxas para llegar a fin de mes; Kelly se da cuenta de que las obras de caridad de su novio benefician su libido.
Jake encuentra a su novia con uno de sus subordinados; Amber se da cuenta de que su novio está involucrado con una de sus amigas de confianza.
Leonard descubre que el gurú de su novia le está dando más que consejos. Sherwood enfrenta también malas noticias.
El novio de mucho tiempo de Angelina está ocultando a una concubina de él; el novio de Amanda se ha enlazado con otra joven.
Todd descubre el comportamiento autodestructivo de su esposa; Olivia se entera de que su novio está planeando un Día de San Valentín muy especial -- con alguien más.
Una mujer descubre que su marido tiene una amante; un hombre descubre que su novia disfruta de la compañía de muchos hombres.
Omar García descubre que su novia está teniendo una aventura con otro. Alicia Woods se entera de que su novio está enamorado de alguien más.
El novio de Amelia se sobreexpone a sí mismo con sus modelos amateurs; la esposa de Rodrigo trabaja horas extras en una habitación específica de un motel.
Un traficante de drogas de poca monta y su novia prostituta se topan con la oportunidad de sus vidas.
Una mujer siente que su esposo no la satisface en la cama. Mientras el marido se encuentra de viaje, aparece en su vida un apuesto primo que la seduce.
Una manera más relajada de comenzar el día.

Charly al quedar huérfano tiene que robar para sobrevivir y se refugia en un gimnasio de boxeo donde se encarga de la limpieza a cambio de comida entrenando en sus ratos libres. Ahora luchará por alcanzar su sueño de disputar un campeonato.
El Caudillo no se detiene ante nada en su búsqueda por el poder, valiéndose de la corrupción, la amenaza y el asesinato.
Unos delincuentes secuestran a un humilde empleado que los descubrió en su último golpe y huyen todos con el botín.
Basado en el clásico de la literatura infantil de José María Sánchez-Silva. La historia de un niño criado en un monasterio franciscano.
Una hermosa periodista realiza un reportaje sobre las bailarinas exóticas, se hace pasar por una de ellas y las consecuencias son terribles.
Ellie y Martín son dos recién casados que han perdido sus respectivos trabajos y tienen que irse a vivir a casa de los padres de ella.
Una mujer (Jennifer Esposito) enumera las cualidades de su hombre perfecto, luego se enamora de un chico (David Sutcliffe) que no cumple ninguno de sus criterios.
Una pareja estadounidense varada en un pueblo mexicano elige ayudar a un niño a alcanzar sus sueños.
Las chispas vuelan entre un problemático cantante de música campirana y la organizadora de un festival.
Una periodista (Laura Leighton) y su mamá (Angie Dickinson) intentan evitar la instalación de un casino en su ciudad natal.
Una escritora viuda de una revista viaja a la ciudad de Mistletoe para conocer a un imitador de Santa Claus.
Una terapeuta (Scout Taylor-Compton) impacta la vida de una anciana matrona (Nancy Linehan Charles) y un joven abogado neoyorquino.
La hija de Santa realiza su primer viaje lejos del Polo Norte durante la temporada navideña con la esperanza de encontrar aventuras y amor en la soleada California.
El rencor entre dos restauranteros vecinos muy pronto se transforma en amor.

Christine, un duende de Santa, se pregunta si podría haber más en la vida que la fabricación de juguetes en el Polo Norte y consigue un trabajo durante las vacaciones, ayudando a una familia en la planificación de un evento de caridad.

Abby es una organizadora de bodas especializada en arreglar bodas que salieron mal. Obligada a trabajar con su exprometido, pronto empieza a cuestionarse si su relación fue el desastre que ella recuerda.
Una mujer viaja a un castillo irlandés después de que su compromiso termina una semana antes de su boda.

El agente Ramírez investiga la constante aparición de cadáveres en callejones de la ciudad. Aunque parezca una locura, todo parece indicar que un vampiro recorre la urbe por la noche, en busca de víctimas o quién sabe qué más.

Un hombre solitario y reprimido sexualmente ve con ojos libidinosos a su vecina, hasta el punto de secuestrarla y encerrarla en un sótano, donde la someterá a toda clase de martirios, buscando que de alguna manera se enamore de él.

Clara trabajaba como asistente de Norman, un escritor. Diez años después, las personas más cercanas de Clara empiezan a morir, una tras otra. Clara está segura de que Norman es el culpable de todo, pero, ¿cómo demostrarlo?

Juanjo, Mario y Lucía viajan a una comunidad Qom en el Impenetrable, un bosque profundo en el norte de Argentina, para realizar un documental que muestre la miseria y la desolación en la que vive el pueblo aborigen, sin imaginar lo que les espera.
En el puerto de Mar del Plata durante la guerra de las Malvinas, un pescador se pierde en un lugar llamado "La Campana", donde el tiempo transcurre muy diferente al tiempo real.
Tres estudiantes universitarios investigan eventos paranormales.

Un crimen ocurrido en un colegio de Padres Franciscanos revela la presencia de un asesino con perfil místico y religioso. Inexplicablemente, una alumna predijo el hecho con un dibujo. Ambos sucesos se relacionan por la niña.
Una joven mujer que atraviesa una crisis económica, una niña y un perro fiel pasan la noche en una casa a punto de derrumbarse, que además que esconde un tesoro y un espíritu atormentado.
Un experimentado detective pierde a su familia en un accidente. Es un hombre solitario y se encuentra investigando una serie de crímenes.
Un portero investiga un guion perdido y despierta horrores ocultos en un edificio maldito de Nueva York.

Lorenzo siempre soñó con ser guapo y gracias a un conjuro su deseo se hizo realidad. Pronto descubrirá que ser tan agraciado no es fácil y justo en el momento que todo es una hermosura, una bella mujer se enamora de él, pero del lado feo.
Aurelia vio a su madre morir. Desde entonces, quiere vengarse de los asesinos.

El cambio climático ha provocado la necesidad de emplear oxígeno artificial para poder respirar. Con su mujer enferma y pocas esperanzas de sobrevivir, Ethan se ve obligado a viajar al futuro para salvar a los humanos.
Tras lograr erradicar la letal pandemia del virus de 2067, la humanidad vive una época de paz y prosperidad. Sin embargo, una sombra se cierne sobre las comunidades de supervivientes.
Ellos crecieron en extrema pobreza, pero sus vidas tomaron rumbos diferentes. Una huella de la infancia marca sus destinos de manera implacable.
Una joven solitaria se refugia en un bosque junto a la playa, con la débil decisión de dejar las drogas. En su exilio encontrará la vida simple de los lugareños, rodeados de trabajo y fe.
Cinco migrantes centroamericanos enfrentan las más duras pruebas para alcanzar el sueño americano.
Una periodista teme que su vida esté estancada hasta que reaparece un exnovio.

Néstor se encuentra estancado en su vida. Su única opción es irse con su hermana a Estados Unidos, pero al vivir con su madre, Lilia, no puede tomar la decisión. Lilia perdió su trabajo y también está buscando su camino.
Poco antes de su regreso final a Argentina, Juan Domingo Perón graba sus recuerdos que vivió en el exilio.
A remote village in Egypt explodes into spiritual warfare when a carpenter, his wife and their son Jesus are targeted by supernatural forces.

A group of social justice warriors, in a quest to free an innocent man, search an abandoned campground for a serial killer. All of them is picked off one by one until it comes down to last person against the killer.
An anthology of stories helmed by more than two dozen directors details 26 ways to die, each corresponding to a different letter of the alphabet.
Twenty-six filmmakers from around the globe helm stories that detail 26 ways to meet your maker, each one corresponding to a different letter of the alphabet.

When a handsome young writer falls for a gorgeous, seductive vampire, their wild romance seems destined for the ages -- until the appearance of her cruel, sex-crazed sister threatens to unravel it all.

When Oskar (Kåre Hedebrant), a sensitive, bullied 12-year-old boy living with his mother in suburban Sweden, meets his new neighbor, the mysterious and moody Eli (Lina Leandersson), they strike up a friendship. Initially reserved with each other, Oskar and Eli slowly form a close bond, but it soon becomes apparent that she is no ordinary young girl. Eventually, Eli shares her dark, macabre secret with Oskar, revealing her connection to a string of bloody local murders.

Mya (Anessa Ramsey) and Ben (Justin Welborn) are very much in love, but she cannot quite find the courage to leave her awful husband, Lewis (A.J. Bowen). However, when a mysterious transmission starts turning people, including Lewis, into murderous maniacs, the lovers must go on the run.

Filmmakers Jovanka Vuckovic, Annie Clark, Roxanne Benjamin and Karyn Kusama present four horrific tales of terror. In "The Box," a boy starts to display strange behavior after looking inside a mysterious gift box. In "The Birthday Party," a woman refuses to let an untimely death ruin her son's bash. In "Don't Fall," an innocent camping trip turns deadly, and in "Her Only Living Son," a mother must deal with the child from hell.
A grieving man relocates his two teenage daughters to a charming town and into their dream home. Quickly, the dream becomes an inescapable nightmare.
Bodies start to pile up when a drug-addicted nurse and her crazed cousin try to find a replacement kidney for an organ trafficker.

Down-and-out backup singer and celebrity ex-husband Kasper is invited to compete in the Funhouse, an online reality show. To rebrand his image and tarnished reputation, Kasper reluctantly accepts the offer. Together with seven other C-list celebrities from around the globe he will compete for the $5 million prize.

New to her stepmother role, Shirin moves into a duplex with her partner, Fredrik, and his son. The home feels like the right place to start becoming a family. However, when Fredrik leaves, strange things are heard from the other, uninhabited side.
Two priests travel to a convent when a nun shows signs of demonic possession.

Five female friends head to the desert for a weekend of restorative scream therapy. Their vacation soon takes a sharp turn when they cross paths with a few deadbeats who are on a very pressing deadline.
The artistry and creativity that bring Cirque du Soleil performances to life.
Fan-favorite Cirque du Soleil songs from shows like Alegria, Kooza, Mystere and more.
Following the cast and crew of KURIOS on tour and what hides in their Cabinet of Curiosities.
Explore the evolution of Cirque du Soleil, from its origins to present-day spectacular productions, capturing the artistic essence and groundbreaking performances.
See some of the most exciting performances from Crystal, Volta, and Luzia.
Behind the curtain of Kooza, Cirque du Soleil's 20th production.
The acrobats and artists of Cirque du Soleil perform acts from seven of Cirque du Soleil's popular shows.

The bidding heats up as everything from race cars to retro people movers and convertibles to classics cross the block in Las Vegas.
The Barrett-Jackson Live auction returns to Las Vegas; bidders go head-to-head over the best selection of collector cars, all at no reserve, from a 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air to a 2017 Maserati Ghibli.

The Doctor tries to prevent Professor Horner from breaking into an ancient barrow.
Devil's End is sealed off from the outside world by a heat barrier.

The Doctor is captured by the villagers who are under the Master's control.
UNIT have penetrated the heat barrier and launch an attack on the gargoyle, Bok.
(1/2) In Little Hodcombe, the townspeople are causing a dormant entity, the Malus, to re-awaken.

The TARDIS takes the Doctor and Jo to the future where colonists are menaced by a monster.
The Interplanetary Mining Corporation, led by Captain Dent, arrives on the planet.
When Jo attempts to break into the IMC ship she is captured and held hostage.
The Master pretends to have come to settle the dispute between the colonists and IMC.
The Master forces the Doctor to take him to the underground city of the primitives.
The Doctor and the Master confront the guardian of the doomsday weapon.
Freedom fighters, trying to change history by traveling back in time to prevent the Daleks from conquering Earth, start a temporal paradox. With Jon Pertwee.
Jo tampers with one of the travelers' time machines and is transported into the future.
Jamie explores Maxtible's house; the Doctor is forced by the Daleks to subject his companion to a series of tests.
The rebel humans are about to change history and the Doctor tries to stop them.
The planet Peladon is hoping to join the Galactic Federation.
The work of the committee is hampered by sabotage, fear and suspicion.
The Doctor is sentenced to a fight to the death.
Hepesh is revealed to be behind the attacks.
The Doctor tries to make peace with reptilian Sea Devils persuaded by the Master to help him dominate man. With Jon Pertwee.
The Doctor discovers that the sea creatures are kin to the Silurians, a race he once helped destroy.
The Master devises equipment to contact the sea creatures and help them regain control of Earth.
The Master and the Sea Devils form an alliance.
The Doctor is brought before the chief Sea Devil and counsels peace.
Under duress, the Doctor helps the Master repair a unit that may revive Sea Devils globally.

The Doctor is sent to a skybase orbiting the planet of Solos in the 30th century, where he must deliver a sealed message pod; on the planet below, something is transforming the human population into hideous mutants.
Ky flees to the planet's poisonous surface, taking Jo with him; the Marshal, holding the Doctor captive, demands that he opens the message pod.
The Doctor gives the box to Ky, revealing the contents to be scrolls written in the language of the Old Ones.
The Doctor and Sondergaard make a discovery in the caves of Solos while Jo falls into the Marshal's trap.
The Doctor and Jo are once again sent into danger by the Time Lords when they are given a vital message capsule to deliver.
The Marshal is on trial, with the Doctor as chief witness; Jo and the Doctor's friends are the Marshal's prisoners.
The Master plans to seize the Crystal of Kronos, gaining power over time itself.
The Master manages to transmit the Lost City's High Priest through time into his laboratory.
The High Priest reveals that the Master has only a portion of the crystal that resides in the temple vaults.
Mainstream album rock from the 60s to today, featuring deep album cuts and hit singles from rock legends.
Destacada activista de la comunidad transgénero en México. Actualmente, es directora de Casa de Muñecas Tiresias, albergue para mujeres transgénero.

El Día de Muertos es ya bien conocido por los habitantes de la República Mexicana, por eso, en este documental se busca la intimidad familiar de quienes celebran y mantienen esta tradición. Las familias partícipes, la preparación de los alimentos, la ofrenda, la banda de música del pueblo, el panteón lleno de flores, que lo convierte, una vez al año en la celebración a la vida de quienes pasaron por aquí.

Espacio donde se reconoce a las grandes voces de la ficción, frente y detrás de cámaras. Se tienen conversaciones íntimas, reveladoras e inspiradoras donde se revela el proceso creativo y los retos de cada personalidad.

Espacio de conversaciones para las grandes figuras del mundo deportivo. Más allá de los triunfos, se indaga sobre sus motivaciones, aprendizajes, desafíos, y todo sobre el lado humano detrás de cada victoria.
Programa que invita al público a disfrutar de un espacio donde se habla de eso que comúnmente no se menciona entre la pareja: el sexo, el amor y las relaciones sexuales no convencionales.
Reporteros relatan distintas historias de crimen y castigo que han estremecido a México.
Navegar por el bullicioso mundo subterráneo del metro de la Ciudad de México: desafíos y sorpresas en cada trayecto.
Un repaso por las tradiciones guatemaltecas.

Ejercicios sencillos y prácticos para realizar en casa que acercarán al público al fascinante mundo de la meditación a través del yoga, una ayuda para desarrollar la coordinación, fuerza, flexibilidad y resistencia.
Lo mejor del mundo fitness llega con diversos ejercicios que se pueden hacer desde casa para fortalecer el cuerpo.
Un programa que presenta un menú de tres tiempos con un toque gourmet, para motivar y despertar la pasión por la cocina.
Espacio con documentales que abordan temas variados sobre la cultura mexicana.
El programa que te muestra el lado más atractivo del golf.
Se resuelven los misterios de distintos oficios y profesiones a través de entrevistas y cápsulas especiales con expertos, todo de manera.
Se habla de lo cotidiano con un giro diferente: desde temas familiares y estilo de vida con un tono ligero y divertido. La regla para el invitado es que debe de tener un impacto social real.
Un espacio para conocer diversos lugares donde comer alrededor de México.

El chef Rómulo Mendoza comparte con Mariano la receta de un delicioso guacamole olmeca con chapulines, preparan juntos chile a la crema y al final se deleitan con el delicioso postre de la casa: el pastel Roldán.
Los sucesos que se viven a diario en el metro de la Ciudad de México. Un recorrido por uno de los sistemas de transporte más grandes.

A lo largo de su carrera, la periodista Carolina Rocha ha recolectado las historias que encuentra en cada rincón de México. Con micrófono en mano, se ha encargado de relatar sobre gastronomía, folklore e historias de vida.
Una entrevista imperdible con el luchador, quien repasa su trayectoria, su rol al frente del Team Villano y revela sus metas a corto plazo en la Arena Naucalpan.
Acción de la noche 3 de los Campeonatos Fire Sports Electronic Striking. Se enfrentan Enrique Horta contra César Sánchez. Desde el Gimnasio de Fire Sports de Apizaco, en Tlaxcala.
Sexto juego del primer playoff de la Zona Sur de la LMB 2026. Bravos de León visita a Olmecas de Tabasco. Desde el Estadio Centenario del 27 de Febrero, en Villahermosa.
Acción con los mejores partidos de Fútbol Tenis.

Jornada 12 del Torneo Apertura 2026 de la Liga Expansión MX. Desde el estadio Gregorio "Tepa" Gómez. El Club Atlético Morelia superó 3-2 a Tepatitlán en la cancha del Estadio Morelos durante la jornada 10 del Torneo Clausura 2026.
Segundo juego de la serie regular de la LNBP 2026. Santos del Potosí se enfrenta a Freseros de Irapuato. Desde el Auditorio Miguel Barragán, en San Luis Potosí.
Semana 6 de la Conferencia 14 Grandes de la Liga Mayor ONEFA 2026. Zorros CETYS visita a Borregos ⚽ [Liga MX] Monterrey. Desde el Estadio Banorte, en ⚽ [Liga MX] Monterrey, Nuevo León.

El boxeo es el protagonista de este espacio en donde se comentan las últimas noticias del deporte y se muestran fragmentos de las peleas más importantes de la jornada con un completo análisis. Acceso exclusivo a los entrenamientos, entrevistas detrás de las cuerdas y análisis comentados por los reconocidos expertos en boxeo Eduardo Lamazon y Carlos Aguilar. Un punto de referencia inigualable para los fanáticos de este deporte, con el cubrimiento más completo de las luchas por los títulos mundiales.

In Manchester, former fashion model Alex Leigh serves a Chinese-inspired menu that causes confusion with her dinner guests with a choice of two not especially Chinese desserts, bread and butter pudding and banoffee pie.
Three couples from Essex compete to see who can throw the best dinner party; the couples are Amie, Mark, Gemma, Nathan, Simon and Suzanne.
Features Sheffield's dining competitors Helen, Claire, Ben, Greg and Rosie.
Five strangers from Belfast, namely Steve, Julie, Justin, Cushla and Marty, compete to throw the best dinner party.
Four strangers from Greater Manchester compete to host the best dinner party; Sukie dishes up a menu from her native South Korea.
Featuring a Caribbean feast, a vegetable banquet and a dark horse.
In Nottingham, Derby and Leicester, Dylan offers a home from home experience, Sam treats her guests to fine dining, crystal healer Angela goes booze-free and Mod Aaron ends with a bang.
Friendships are made; secrets are revealed; outrageous outfits are de rigueur.
Amateur chefs compete to host the ultimate dinner party, with shocking guests and delicious entertainment.
Businessman Sani attempts to impress his dinner guests, Jane, Sharon and Stephen, with an African-inspired cuisine.
Four contestants from York host dinner.
Will it be a fairy tale ending for Diane, or will Kay show them how it's done?

When a British TV show becomes popular, an American network often makes its own version of the show. In this case, Lifetime is importing this series that pits four amateur cooks against one another as they compete for a cash prize. Each contestant prepares a meal for a dinner party -- with a unique theme, location and menu -- for the other competitors, who critique and score the cook. The contestant who earns the most points for his or her party wins the title of the host with the most and, more importantly, the money. Radio personality Todd Pettengill narrates the series.

This week's group is split into two factions: those who believe dinner parties are all about atmosphere and the others who think food is most important; Bryan, the night's host, is part of the former faction.
A rock band manager called Mel hopes to impress with some traditional dishes that she learned from her mother.
Rita surprises her guests by attempting to create a nine-course tasting menu of old favorites and new recipes she loves.
James is hoping to impress his dinner party guests with some modern rustic dishes and a Parisian nightclub setting.
Nicole is worried that her party may not be enough to impress after a full week of tasting menus, dressing up, and fine wine; the winner is revealed.
Financial adviser Tony, the first host of the week, throws a big fish BBQ night; however, one hard-to-impress guest hates his food.
Celeste's dinner party features a very ambitious menu as well as a few surprises for her guests, but only time will tell if it's going to be enough to win.
Lawyer Nicole attempts to outdo Celeste's night of fine food by buying the biggest octopus she can find; however, she's going to have to face a tough culinary jury.
Stephen, the "funny guy" in the finance office, puts on a Halloween-themed dinner party; however, his menu may be more trick than treat.
Single mom and promotional printing business owner Sheeneagh hosts the final night, hoping to serve up a winning menu; the week's winner is revealed.
The queen of cooking, Lianne, is up against Lee's Rat Pack-themed evening.
Canadian comedian Larah kicks off the competition in Edinburgh; she hopes to bag herself the prize with an evening of fine dining.
The second night of competition sees café owner Nutan hosting and hoping that her upbeat attitude will see her through to victory.
The competition heads to Edinburgh, where South African born family man Sindiso hosts; Sindiso is hoping his South African-themed night will win him the prize.
Security company manager Anne hosts in Edinburgh and hopes that her relaxed night will win her the prize money.

Lashoun got daughter Jelisha involved in a lingerie basketball league, but this isn't the path Jelisha wants to pursue; Roselee has been cashing in on her fame on social media but says Jeremiah is having a hard time accepting she's the breadwinner.
John and Shay share their struggles of having a blended family; Barbara does the best she can in raising her 16-year-old niece, Ayonna, who is making bad choices.

Victoria believes Queecha and Vincent are her long-lost brother and sister, but the two aren't convinced that Victoria is part of their family; Candi lost her salon to a fire and blames her former friend, Patsy, for the blaze.

Brianna's boyfriend, Taylor, cheats on her, but she wants to try to make things work for the sake of their children; Reanna wants to salvage her marriage, but Everett isn't certain he wants to stay married to her.
Zakirah is tired of boyfriend J'Quan's cheating accusations; pregnant Sharma wants to address the abuse she endured from her mother, Stephanie.

After a night of too much drinking, Ro Ro says that some of her money went missing, and she suspects her cousin and a former friend; John wants to know if he is the biological dad of daughter Caitlin, whose birth certificate says "father unknown."

Anissa says a man named Nate rescued her from an untenable situation, and she believes he is her biological father; Infinity says her mother was emotionally and physically abusive toward her, while her mom says they used to be best friends.
At first, Neshay thought Michael was her cousin, but it turns out that he may be her father: Karamo tries to end a 29-year-old riddle; Kyla and Josh return with a wonderful update.

Un hombre con una orden de arresto intenta escapar de la policía. Durante la persecución provoca destrozos a su paso y pone en peligro a su prometida, por lo que se le asignan más cargos y es llevado a la cárcel.

La policía atiende un robo por bicicleta y persigue a un hombre, que al ser interrogado se comporta de forma agresiva. Se realiza un operativo para atrapar al vendedor unas pelotas de béisbol robadas.

La policía detiene a una pareja por una infracción vehicular, pero el hombre huye sin razón, así que va a la cárcel por evadir a la autoridad. Por otro lado, un oficial atiende un caso por un auto robado.

Un oficial de policía detiene a una pareja y descubre un olor fuerte a marihuana en el auto, el pasajero escapa por llevar una bolsa llena de hierba y confiesa que es para venta. Una mujer es reportada por robar varias veces mercancía de una tienda.

Un hombre es reportado por estar corriendo en la calle agitando una arma y la policía deduce que su comportamiento es por un consumo excesivo de marihuana. La policía detiene a un auto que sale de un hotel conocido por venta de narcóticos.

La policía, con la ayuda de la unidad canina, atiende un intento de robo. Un hombre entra a la fuerza a la casa de su madre porque quiere quitarse la vida y ahí tiene armas. Un hombre es arrestado por robar una camioneta e inventa una historia para justificarse.

Reportan a un hombre agresivo que amenazó al empleado de una tienda con una sierra y además tiene una orden de arresto, así que deberá enfrentar la corte. La policía encuentra un auto reportado como robado y el sujeto a bordo es la expareja de la dueña.

Un hombre es detenido por traer los vidrios polarizados del coche, la policía descubre que tiene órdenes de arresto por posesión de droga y encuentran más sustancias en el coche. El oficial solo lo multa y le ofrece ayuda para superar la adicción.

La policía persigue un auto reportado como robado y descubre que el conductor está armado. Por lo que, lo arrestan por ambos delitos, posesión de auto robado y una arma cargada sin tener permiso para portarla.

Una oficial de policía detiene un auto por violar el código vehicular y descubre a una pareja con actitud sospechosa: además de no tener identificación poseen varias drogas en el auto. La policía impone la multa y les recomienda dejar las adicciones.

Un oficial encuentra a un joven que conoce que está en libertad condicional junto con otro hombre, a quien investigan y resulta ser un delincuente con varios cargos y posesión de sustancias controladas.

La policía intercepta a un hombre sospechoso que está estacionado en un parque, el cual se molesta al ser interrogado y confiesa tener drogas en el auto. Dos hombres son detenidos por posesión de drogas, quienes niegan ser los propietarios.

Un hombre inicia una persecución por evadir a la policía, y al lograr detenerlo, el oficial reconoce al sujeto porque ya lo había arrestado antes. El hombre, además de tener una basta cantidad de balas, viola la libertad condicional.

Un oficial interroga a un hombre sospechoso en la calle, el cual intenta huir, pero es arrestado por posesión de drogas. Se reporta a un hombre armado que está exigiendo dinero dentro de una tienda. La policía lo detiene por tener una arma sin permiso.

Una mujer delincuente convicta es arrestada por posesión de un auto robado y un arma de fuego, por lo que irá a la cárcel. Un oficial debe intervenir en un caso de violencia doméstica para ayudar a un matrimonio.
La policía arresta a una mujer por intentar robar una camioneta y autopartes. Un oficial investiga una discusión entre un hombre que exige dinero y un agente de bienes raíces.

Un joven le miente a la policía y huye porque acaba de salir de la cárcel, pero es detenido por posesión de drogas. Un hombre es arrestado por ser un ladrón en serie: tiene en su poder una moto, varias llaves de autos y herramientas para robarlos.

Una mujer reporta que un hombre la golpeó e intentó robar su auto. El sospechoso asegura que él es el dueño del auto, así que es detenido por robo, agresión, falsa identidad y otros cargos. Un hombre es arrestado por posesión de auto robado.

Los agentes de seguridad de un estacionamiento reportan a un hombre violento que no quiere irse del lugar. El oficial interroga al sujeto y lo arresta por amenazar a la gente. Un caso de violencia familiar es atendido por la policía.

Durante una parada de tráfico rutinaria, un tío queda atónito después de que los oficiales descubren que su sobrino oculta objetos ilegales dentro del vehículo. Agentes intervienen en una discusión donde viejas relaciones provocan conflictos.

Una fuerte discusión entre un matrimonio intoxicado con alcohol y metanfetamina obliga a los oficiales a buscar pruebas. Una mujer detenida por drogas asegura que la heroína es lo único que calma su dolor.

Los oficiales corren contra el tiempo después de que un incendio en una vivienda deja a un niño atrapado en el interior. Mientras equipos de emergencia responden, otro incidente enfrenta a los oficiales con un cliente ebrio que exige alcohol fiado en una tienda.

Una motocicleta sin placas intenta escapar de los oficiales y termina estrellándose durante la persecución. Una mujer conduce un auto sin parabrisas y culpa a su exnovio por el daño, mientras una parada de tráfico revela un arma escondida bajo un asiento.

Los oficiales investigan el violento ataque contra un hombre cuyo cuello fue cortado mientras esperaba a su esposa. Más tarde, un conductor queda sorprendido al descubrir que el camión de mudanza que rentó ha sido reportado como robado.

La serie cuenta, en cada capítulo, una historia diferente con personajes nuevos. El eje central de las historias es el transporte público, ya que todas ellas suceden dentro de alguno de los medios de traslado del país.

Tiff Needell and Jason Plato pit a BMW Z4 against an Audi TT, Vicki Butler-Henderson sees how tough a Daihatsu Charade can be, and Tiff tries out a three-wheeled car. Meanwhile, Jonny Smith goes to Germany to watch the new Corsa being put through its paces.
Tom Ford tests the Bentley Azure with help from Michael Winner, and Jonny Smith tries to drive coast to coast using chip fat as fuel.

War is declared in a tank 'dogfight', Jonny goes for a spin in a 🏌️ [Golf] Golf GTI, Tom teams up with DJ Judge Jules to road-test the Aston Martin DBS Volante, Tim inspects the state of Britain's roads, and Tiff casts his eye over the first new Lotus in 13 years.

Vicki Butler-Henderson compares Audi TT's: how will one with a semi-automatic gearbox fare against one with a manual? Four leading brands of fuel additives are subjected to scientific tests, and Tom Ford reports on the new Fiat 500.

Olympic cyclist Bradley Wiggins meets Jason at 'Fifth Gear's' velodrome, Tiff pits Renault Mégane hatch against a Caterham CDX sports car, and Vicki demonstrates the racing capabilities of the BMW 330d. Away from the track, Tim delves into the murky world of car crime, Jonny gives a consumer review of the new Ford Ka, and Tom enlists the help of a Guns 'N' Roses tribute band to push the Fiat Qubo to the limit.

Comic prankster Dom Joly makes a guest appearance, causing all sorts of mayhem as he road-tests a tank in the Cotswolds. Meanwhile, Tom Ford goes head-to-head with Jonny Smith in a Reliant Robin demolition derby.

Tiff Needell drives the Lamborghini Gallardo Superleggera. Chip-fat evangelist Jonny Smith goes to meet another pioneer of alternative fuels - a cider farmer who uses rotten apples to produce methane that powers his Jaguar and Tom Ford drives.
Tiff Needell tests the theory that the quicker you drive a convertible, the less the wind blows you about, by driving the brand-new Bentley Continental GTC up to 150mph.
Jason goes off-roading with rugby ace Phil Vickery and Tiff puts the new Lexus IS F through its paces on the track. Tom takes the new Volvo XC70 to extremes in the Arctic Circle.
Tiff and the team test the most exciting cars on the road. Vicki risks life and limb to drive a car under a moving lorry and actor Chris Barrie fulfils his driving dream.
Jason goes in search of a supercar for the same price as a Ford Fiesta Style, Tiff checks out the environmentally friendly Lotus Exige 265E and Tom test drives the new Volvo C30.
It's the 100th anniversary of the Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost so, to celebrate, Tom and Jonny build an armoured version of one. Plus, it's time for the Fifth Gear Awards.

Tiff Needell and Jason Plato race two V8 mega-saloons. Tom Ford has the only television test of the charismatic Dodge Challenger. Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which car is quickest between the Vauxhall Astra Nürburgring and Ford Focus ST.

Tom drives the new Volkswagen Scirocco around Wales. Jason teaches Moto GP star James Toseland to drift in the new Aston Martin V8 Vantage. Jonny finds out if new Jeep Wrangler is better or worse than a Willys Jeep from World War II.
Tim samples the craze for car share clubs, and Jason arranges a treat for chef and car fanatic James Martin at Silverstone.
Jonny road tests the Mercedes-Benz McLaren SLR Roadster, Jason Plato drives the Bowler Nemesis - an extreme off-roader designed for tough rallying and Patrick McGuinness takes his motorbike test.
Tiff puts the Caterham Roadsport 175 through an unusual test that checks out the vehicle's practicality and performance.

Vicki Butler-Henderson attempts to become the fastest A1 🏎️ [F1] Grand Prix car driver by reaching 200mph, `Phoenix Nights' star Paddy McGuinness takes his motorcycle test, but struggles to master the compulsory training, and Tom Ford and Jonny Smith check out new hatchbacks.
Vicki finds out if an old Daihatsu Charade is the toughest car you can buy, and Tim learns to park in an impossibly small gap.
Tom discovers ways to beat the wheel clampers and John Travolta reveals his passion for cars. Meanwhile, the cast of 'Hollyoaks' take on a series of boy versus girl challenges.
Tiff and Jonny have fun with four tiny hot hatches: the 500 Abarth, Mitsubishi Colt Ralliart, Renault Sport Twingo and Suzuki Swift Sport.

Tiff Needell takes boxer Joe Calzaghe and his girlfriend Jo-Emma on a crash course of off-road driving. Jonny Smith has a look at the Volkswagen 🏌️ [Golf] Golf's latest model, while Vicki Butler-Henderson takes a spin in Sicily in the new Ferrari California.

Vicki Butler-Henderson goes behind the scenes of a spectacular Hollywood car stunt, Tiff and Jason go head-to-head in the most exciting race in 'Fifth Gear' history, and Tom Ford tests the latest Toyota Land Cruiser.
Tiff tests out the Caterham Roadsport 175 by turning medical courier, and Torchwood star John Barrowman gets a crash course in rally driving.

Jason Plato practises some extreme piloting skills with the Blue Eagle army helicopter regiment, Vicki Butler-Henderson puts the brand new Honda Jazz through its paces, and actor Dirk Benedict, best known as Face from 'The A-Team', joins Jonny Smith to road test the Mercedes S-Class. Plus, Tim Shaw finds out if it is possible for motorists to save money by servicing their cars themselves.
Tom Ford test drives stunning Aussie supercar the Vauxhall Monaro and Vicki Butler-Henderson fulfils a lifetime ambition by driving a racing truck.
Against the Audi RS6, and Vicki sees the technology in the new BMW 5 Series.
British downhill skier Chemmy Alcott joins Jason for some off-road driving in a Group N rally car while Tiff and Jonny report from behind the scenes at the 50th NASCAR 🏁 [NASCAR] Daytona 500.
While Jonny tests whether some of the cheapest cars can make it to the top of Britain's steepest road, Vicki finds out whether a police driver or a racing driver is the faster.
While Tom drives the Land Rover Defender to an Icelandic glacier, Blur's Alex James bungee jumps from a crane. Meanwhile, a Ford GT and a Formula Ford go head-to-head.
Jason Plato finds out just how fast cricketer Shane Warne is on a track, and Jonny Smith and Tom Ford battle it out to decide which is best - a diesel Mini Cooper or petrol one.
Vicki Butler-Henderson takes the new Fiat Panda 100HP for a spin around the track - against a Ferrari, and Tiff Needell hits Las Vegas to try out Audi's first supercar, the R8.

Vicki chauffeurs comedian Bill Bailey around town in a very unusual Mercedes, Tom Ford test-drives the funky new Kia Soul, Jonny presents his pick of the best budget cabriolets, and Tim Shaw reveals how the crumbling economy equals big savings on new vehicles. Also, this week, there is a classic Fifth Gear shootout, and Tiff takes the new Lamborghini Gallardo LP560-4 for a spin.
The team investigate car culture in Romania, testing extreme off-road vehicles in its countryside and ski resorts and meeting a classic car restorer in Bucharest.

Tiff and Jason put pedal to metal on the Yas Marina in Abu Dhabi, and Vicki zips around the winding streets of Monaco in a £40,000 hot hatch. Back in Britain, Jonny meets an ingenious car engineer and in the Team Test, the foursome reviews the BMW X3 four-wheel drive.
Jonny goes behind the scenes at the gruelling Isle of Man TT motorbike race with TT hero John McGuinness. Plus, how will the new Subaru BRZ sports car handle the infamous circuit?
Tiff and Jason race two of the fastest off-roaders on the market - the Audi Q7 V12 and the Porsche Cayenne Turbo.
Jonny visits the firm who chromed Sir Elton John's Audi R8, and tries to do the same with an old Metro. And the team investigates whether it is possible to have a diesel sports car.

Featuring Regian Eersel vs. Samy Sana for the super middleweight title, Iman Barlow vs. Meryum Uslu for the women's super bantamweight title, Anthony Njokuani vs. Chris Harrington and more. From Las Vegas.
